local function createGeneralizedIterator(iteratorFunction, iteratorState, iteratorControl)
    if type(iteratorFunction) ~= "function" then
        local mt = getmetatable(iteratorFunction)

        if type(mt) == "table" and mt.__iter then
            iteratorFunction, iteratorState, iteratorControl = mt.__iter(iteratorFunction)
        elseif type(iteratorFunction) == "table" then
            iteratorFunction, iteratorState, iteratorControl = next, iteratorFunction, nil
        end
    end

    return function()
        local iterationResults = table.pack(iteratorFunction(iteratorState, iteratorControl))

        if iterationResults[1] == nil then
            return false
        end

        iteratorControl = iterationResults[1]

        return true, table.unpack(iterationResults, 1, iterationResults.n)
    end
end

                if value92.Parent then
                    if value92.Visible then
                        return

                    local now = os.clock()

                    if
                        now

                        > 0.5
                    then
                        application.controller._mobileShiftLockLastRestore[value92] = now
                        value92.Visible = true
                    else
                        return
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        value92.Visible = missingConstants[577]
    end,
}

application.controller._ensureMobileShiftLock = function()
    local result92 = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[301])

    if not result92 then
        return
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(result92:GetDescendants()) do
        application.controller._watchMobileShiftLock(descendant)
    end

    if application.controller._mobileShiftLockDescConn then
        application.controller._mobileShiftLockDescConn:Disconnect()
    end

    application.controller._mobileShiftLockDescConn =
        result92.DescendantAdded:Connect(application.controller._watchMobileShiftLock)
end

            task.defer(application.controller._ensureMobileShiftLock)
        end
    end)
end)

safeIsWeaponName = function(value93)
    local text5 = tostring(value93):lower()

    for _2, value3 in ipairs(SAFE_WEAPON_WORDS) do
        if text5:find(value3, missingConstants[711], true) then
            return missingConstants[577]
        end
    end

    return missingConstants[357]
end

safeIsIgnoredModel = function(value94)
    local text6 = value94.Name:lower()

    if SAFE_IGNORE_NAMES[text6] or safeIsWeaponName(text6) then
        return true
    end

    if value94:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[322]) then
        return missingConstants[577]
    end

    if value94:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(missingConstants[49], true) then
        return missingConstants[577]
    end

    return false
end
safeIsBodyPart = function(value95, value96)
    return value95 and value96 and value95:IsDescendantOf(value96)
end

safeCarryValueActive = function(value97)
    return value97
        and (
            value97:IsA("BoolValue") and value97.Value
            or value97:IsA("ObjectValue") and value97.Value ~= nil
            or value97:IsA(missingConstants[496]) and value97.Value ~= ""
        )
end

safeIsCarrying = function()
    local Character2 = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character2 then
        return missingConstants[357]
    end

    if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") ~= missingConstants[577] then
        if
            LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(missingConstants[382]) ~= missingConstants[577]
            and Character2:GetAttribute("Stealing") ~= missingConstants[577]
        then
            for _3, value4 in ipairs({
                missingConstants[34],
                "IsCarrying",
                missingConstants[222],
                missingConstants[653],
                missingConstants[48],
                missingConstants[115],
            }) do
                local result102 = Character2:FindFirstChild(value4, missingConstants[577])

                if safeCarryValueActive(result102) then
                    return true
                end
            end

            for _4, child2 in ipairs(Character2:GetChildren()) do
                if not child2:IsA(missingConstants[484]) or safeIsWeaponName(child2.Name) then
                    continue
                end

                return true
            end

            for _5, child3 in ipairs(Character2:GetChildren()) do
                local text7 = child3.Name:lower()

                if
                    child3:IsA("Model")
                    and child3:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    and not safeIsIgnoredModel(child3)
                    and (
                        text7:find("brainrot")
                        or text7:find("animal")
                        or text7:find("carry")
                        or text7:find("grab")
                        or text7:find("steal")
                        or text7:find("hold")
                    )
                then
                    return true
                end
            end

            for _6, descendant2 in ipairs(Character2:GetDescendants()) do
                if not descendant2:IsA("BasePart") then
                    continue
                end

                for _7, value5 in ipairs(descendant2:GetJoints()) do
                    if
                        value5:IsA(missingConstants[60])
                        or value5:IsA(missingConstants[439])
                        or value5:IsA("Motor6D")
                        or value5:IsA("ManualWeld")
                    then
                        local Part1

                        if not value5.Part0 or safeIsBodyPart(value5.Part0, Character2) then
                            if value5.Part1 and not safeIsBodyPart(value5.Part1, Character2) then
                                Part1 = value5.Part1
                            end
                        else
                            Part1 = value5.Part0
                        end

                        if not Part1 then
                            continue
                        end

                        if safeIsWeaponName(Part1.Name) then
                            continue
                        end

                        local result112 = Part1:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(missingConstants[753])

                        if not result112 or not players2:GetPlayerFromCharacter(result112) then
                            return missingConstants[577]
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return missingConstants[357]
        end
    end

    return missingConstants[577]
end

_waveKickWarningCarried = function()
    local Character3 = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character3 then
        return missingConstants[357]
    end

    if _isCarryingBrainrot() then
        return missingConstants[577]
    end

    if safeIsCarrying() then
        return true
    end

    for _8, value6 in ipairs({
        missingConstants[34],
        missingConstants[67],
        missingConstants[222],
        missingConstants[653],
        missingConstants[115],
    }) do
        local result12 = Character3:FindFirstChild(value6, missingConstants[577])

        if safeCarryValueActive(result12) then
            return true
        end
    end

    for _9, child4 in ipairs(Character3:GetChildren()) do
        local text8 = child4.Name:lower()

        if
            child4:IsA("Model")
            and child4:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", missingConstants[577])
            and not safeIsIgnoredModel(child4)
            and (
                text8:find(missingConstants[672])
                or text8:find(missingConstants[80])
                or text8:find(missingConstants[389])
                or text8:find("grab")
            )
        then
            return missingConstants[577]
        end
    end

    for _10, descendant3 in ipairs(Character3:GetDescendants()) do
        if not descendant3:IsA(missingConstants[729]) then
            continue
        end

        for _11, value7 in ipairs(descendant3:GetJoints()) do
            local exitTo

            repeat
                exitTo = 1

                break

            until true

            if exitTo == 1 then
                if
                    not (
                        value7:IsA(missingConstants[60])
                        or value7:IsA(missingConstants[439])
                        or value7:IsA(missingConstants[207])
                        or value7:IsA(missingConstants[232])
                    )
                then
                    continue
                end

                local Part12

                if not value7.Part0 or safeIsBodyPart(value7.Part0, Character3) then
                    if value7.Part1 and not safeIsBodyPart(value7.Part1, Character3) then
                        Part12 = value7.Part1
                    end
                else
                    Part12 = value7.Part0
                end

                if not Part12 or safeIsWeaponName(Part12.Name) then
                    continue
                end

                local result13 = Part12:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(missingConstants[753])

                if not result13 or not players2:GetPlayerFromCharacter(result13) then
                    return missingConstants[577]
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return missingConstants[357]
end

runtimeState.collectPlotSpawnPositions = function()
    local spots = {}
    local Plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")

    if Plots then
        for _12, child5 in ipairs(Plots:GetChildren()) do
            local result14 = child5:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[690])
            local result15 = result14 and result14:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[58])

            if
                not (
                    result15
                    and result15:IsA(missingConstants[546])
                    and result15.Enabled == missingConstants[577]
                )
            then
                local result16 = child5:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[542])

                if result16 then
                    for _13, child22 in ipairs(result16:GetChildren()) do
                        local result17 = child22:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[14])
                        local Spawn = result17 and result17:FindFirstChild("Spawn")

                        if Spawn then
                            spots[#spots + missingConstants[711]] = Spawn.Position
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    _waveAutoCarryV2.spots = spots
end

runtimeState.findCharacterRoot = function(character2)
    local character22 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[497])

    if not character22 then
        return false
    end

    if
        typeof(_G._RaVeStealTargetPos) == missingConstants[52]
        and (character22.Position - _G._RaVeStealTargetPos).Magnitude <= missingConstants[205]
    then
        return missingConstants[577]
    end

    local now2 = tick()

    if _waveAutoCarryV2.nextScan <= now2 then
        _waveAutoCarryV2.nextScan = now2 + missingConstants[589]
        runtimeState.collectPlotSpawnPositions()
    end

    for _14, spot in ipairs(_waveAutoCarryV2.spots) do
        if (character22.Position - spot).Magnitude <= 15 then
            return missingConstants[577]
        end
    end

    return false
end

runtimeState.resetAutomaticCarryState = function()
    _waveAutoCarryV2.latched = missingConstants[357]
    _waveAutoCarryV2.held = missingConstants[357]
    _waveAutoCarryV2.graceUntil = missingConstants[182]
    _waveAutoCarryV2.armed = missingConstants[577]
end

runtimeState.getCharacterRootPosition = function(character3)
    local characterRoot6 = runtimeState.findCharacterRoot(character3)
    local result18 = _waveBrainrotCarried()

    if not characterRoot6 then
        _waveAutoCarryV2.armed = true
    end

    if not characterRoot6 or not _waveAutoCarryState.active then
        _waveAutoCarryV2.latched = false
    end

    if characterRoot6 then
        if _waveAutoCarryV2.armed and not _waveAutoCarryV2.latched then
            _waveAutoCarryV2.latched = missingConstants[577]
            _waveAutoCarryV2.held = false
            _waveAutoCarryEnable()
        end
    end

    if _waveAutoCarryState.active then
        if result18 then
            _waveAutoCarryV2.held = true
            _waveAutoCarryV2.graceUntil = tick() + 0.75
        elseif _waveAutoCarryV2.held then
            _waveAutoCarryV2.held = missingConstants[357]
            _waveAutoCarryV2.latched = missingConstants[357]
            _waveAutoCarryV2.armed = missingConstants[357]
            _waveAutoCarryDisable()
        elseif not characterRoot6 and _waveAutoCarryV2.graceUntil < tick() then
            _waveAutoCarryV2.latched = false
            _waveAutoCarryDisable()
        end
    end
end

_waveAutoCarryRefreshVisual = function()
    if not runtimeState.settings2.laggerEnabled then
        if application.controller.setSpeedMode then
            application.controller.setSpeedMode(
                runtimeState.settings2.speedToggled and "Carry" or "Normal"
            )
        end
    elseif updateLaggerDisplay then
        updateLaggerDisplay()
    end

    if runtimeState.entries2.carrySpeed then
        runtimeState.entries2.carrySpeed.setOn(runtimeState.settings2.speedToggled)
    end
end
_waveAutoCarryEnable = function()
    if _waveAutoCarryState.active then
        return
    end

    _waveAutoCarryState.previous = runtimeState.settings2.speedToggled
    _waveAutoCarryState.previousLagger = runtimeState.settings2.laggerEnabled
    _waveAutoCarryState.previousLaggerVariant = runtimeState.settings2.laggerVariant or 1
    _waveAutoCarryState.active = missingConstants[577]

    if runtimeState.settings2.laggerEnabled then
        runtimeState.settings2.laggerVariant = missingConstants[62]
    else
        runtimeState.settings2.speedToggled = missingConstants[577]
    end

    _waveAutoCarryRefreshVisual()
end
_waveAutoCarryDisable = function()
    if not _waveAutoCarryState.active then
        return
    end

    local previousLaggerVariant = _waveAutoCarryState.previousLaggerVariant or missingConstants[711]

    _waveAutoCarryState.active = missingConstants[357]
    _waveAutoCarryState.previous = missingConstants[357]
    _waveAutoCarryState.previousLagger = missingConstants[357]
    _waveAutoCarryState.previousLaggerVariant = 1
    runtimeState.settings2.speedToggled = _waveAutoCarryState.previous and missingConstants[577]
        or missingConstants[357]
    runtimeState.settings2.laggerEnabled = _waveAutoCarryState.previousLagger and true
        or missingConstants[357]
    runtimeState.settings2.laggerVariant = previousLaggerVariant
    _waveAutoCarryRefreshVisual()
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.14)

        local now3 = tick()
        local isEnabled13 = false

        if
            not (
                runtimeState.settings2.autoSwitchSpeedEnabled
                or runtimeState.settings2.kickWarningEnabled
                or runtimeState.settings2.autoLaggerEnabled
                or _waveCarryCached
            )
        then
            if _isCarryingBrainrot() then
                _waveCarryLastTrue = now3
            end

            _waveCarryCached = now3 - _waveCarryLastTrue < _waveCarryHold

            if not runtimeState.settings2.autoSwitchSpeedEnabled then
                _waveAutoCarryDisable()

                runtimeState.resetAutomaticCarryState()

                continue
            end

            if not runtimeState.settings2.dropEnabled then
                if runtimeState.settings2.autoCarryMode == "V2" then
                    runtimeState.getCharacterRootPosition(LocalPlayer.Character)
                elseif _waveBrainrotCarried() then
                    _waveAutoCarryEnable()
                else
                    _waveAutoCarryDisable()
                end

                continue
            end

            if tostring(runtimeState.settings2.dropMode):lower() == "stand" then
                _waveAutoCarryDisable()

                break
            elseif runtimeState.settings2.autoCarryMode == "V2" then
                runtimeState.getCharacterRootPosition(LocalPlayer.Character)
            elseif _waveBrainrotCarried() then
                _waveAutoCarryEnable()
            else
                _waveAutoCarryDisable()
            end

            continue
        end

        while true do
            pcall(function()
                isEnabled13 = safeIsCarrying()
            end)

            while true do
                if isEnabled13 or _isCarryingBrainrot() then
                    _waveCarryLastTrue = now3
                end

                _waveCarryCached = now3 - _waveCarryLastTrue < _waveCarryHold

                if runtimeState.settings2.autoSwitchSpeedEnabled then
                    if not runtimeState.settings2.dropEnabled then
                        if runtimeState.settings2.autoCarryMode == "V2" then
                            runtimeState.getCharacterRootPosition(LocalPlayer.Character)
                        elseif _waveBrainrotCarried() then
                            _waveAutoCarryEnable()
                        else
                            _waveAutoCarryDisable()
                        end

                        task.wait(0.14)
                        now3 = tick()
                        isEnabled13 = false

                        if
                            runtimeState.settings2.autoSwitchSpeedEnabled
                            or runtimeState.settings2.kickWarningEnabled
                            or runtimeState.settings2.autoLaggerEnabled
                            or _waveCarryCached
                        then
                            break
                        end

                        continue
                    end

                    if tostring(runtimeState.settings2.dropMode):lower() ~= "stand" then
                        if runtimeState.settings2.autoCarryMode == "V2" then
                            runtimeState.getCharacterRootPosition(LocalPlayer.Character)
                        elseif _waveBrainrotCarried() then
                            _waveAutoCarryEnable()
                        else
                            _waveAutoCarryDisable()
                        end

                        task.wait(0.14)
                        now3 = tick()
                        isEnabled13 = false

                        if
                            runtimeState.settings2.autoSwitchSpeedEnabled
                            or runtimeState.settings2.kickWarningEnabled
                            or runtimeState.settings2.autoLaggerEnabled
                            or _waveCarryCached
                        then
                            break
                        end

                        continue
                    end
                end

                _waveAutoCarryDisable()
                runtimeState.resetAutomaticCarryState()
                task.wait(0.14)
                now3 = tick()
                isEnabled13 = false

                if
                    runtimeState.settings2.autoSwitchSpeedEnabled
                    or runtimeState.settings2.kickWarningEnabled
                    or runtimeState.settings2.autoLaggerEnabled
                    or _waveCarryCached
                then
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    (nil)(nil)
end)

_safeModeBlocked = function()
    return _isCarryingBrainrot()
end

_enforceSafeMode = function()
    if not _safeModeBlocked() then
        return false
    end

    if runtimeState.settings2.autoLeftEnabled then
        runtimeState.settings2.autoLeftEnabled = false

        if application.controller.stopAutoLeft then
            application.controller.stopAutoLeft()
        end

        if runtimeState.entries2.autoLeft then
            runtimeState.entries2.autoLeft.setOn(missingConstants[357])
        end
    end

    if runtimeState.settings2.autoRightEnabled then
        runtimeState.settings2.autoRightEnabled = false

        if application.controller.stopAutoRight then
            application.controller.stopAutoRight()
        end

        if runtimeState.entries2.autoRight then
            runtimeState.entries2.autoRight.setOn(false)
        end
    end

    if runtimeState.settings2.batAimbotToggled then
        runtimeState.settings2.batAimbotToggled = missingConstants[357]

        if application.controller.stopBatAimbot then
            application.controller.stopBatAimbot()
        end

        if runtimeState.entries2.aimbot then
            runtimeState.entries2.aimbot.setOn(false)
        end

        if application.controller.setBatAimbotToggle then
            application.controller.setBatAimbotToggle(missingConstants[357])
        end

        if runtimeState.refreshBatAimCarryState then
            runtimeState.refreshBatAimCarryState()
        end
    end

    if runtimeState.settings2.antiDesyncEnabled then
        runtimeState.settings2.antiDesyncEnabled = false

        if application.controller.stopAntiDesync then
            application.controller.stopAntiDesync()
        end

        if runtimeState.entries2.antiDesync then
            runtimeState.entries2.antiDesync.setOn(missingConstants[357])
        end

        if application.controller.setAntiDesyncToggle then
            application.controller.setAntiDesyncToggle(missingConstants[357])
        end

        if runtimeState.refreshBatAimCarryState then
            runtimeState.refreshBatAimCarryState()
        end
    end

    return missingConstants[577]
end

runtimeState.getGrayscaleThemeColor = function(brightness)
    local clampedValue = math.clamp(math.floor(brightness + 0.5), missingConstants[182], 255)

    return Color3.fromRGB(clampedValue, clampedValue, clampedValue)
end

runtimeState.interpolateThemeColor = function(firstColor, secondColor, blendFraction)
    local clampedValue2 = math.clamp(blendFraction, missingConstants[182], missingConstants[711])

    return Color3.fromRGB(
        math.floor(firstColor.R * 255 + (secondColor.R - firstColor.R) * 255 * clampedValue2 + 0.5),
        math.floor(
            firstColor.G * missingConstants[571]
                + (secondColor.G - firstColor.G) * missingConstants[571] * clampedValue2
                + missingConstants[589]
        ),
        math.floor(
            firstColor.B * 255
                + (secondColor.B - firstColor.B) * missingConstants[571] * clampedValue2
                + missingConstants[589]
        )
    )
end

runtimeState.getKiraThemeGradient = function(brightness2)
    local clampedValue3 = math.clamp(brightness2, missingConstants[182], missingConstants[571])
    local result19 =
        Color3.fromRGB(missingConstants[248], missingConstants[138], missingConstants[17])
    local result20 = Color3.fromRGB(missingConstants[307], 18, missingConstants[81])
    local result21 = Color3.fromRGB(missingConstants[446], 90, missingConstants[405])
    local result222 = Color3.fromRGB(237, missingConstants[580], missingConstants[549])

    if clampedValue3 < 70 then
        return runtimeState.interpolateThemeColor(
            result19,
            result20,
            (clampedValue3 - 18) / missingConstants[230]
        )
    end

    if clampedValue3 < 125 then
        return runtimeState.interpolateThemeColor(
            result20,
            result21,
            (clampedValue3 - missingConstants[413]) / 55
        )
    end

    return runtimeState.interpolateThemeColor(
        result21,
        result222,
        (clampedValue3 - missingConstants[473]) / 70
    )
end
runtimeState.getKingCrimsonThemeGradient = function(brightness3)

    local result23 =
        Color3.fromRGB(missingConstants[650], missingConstants[303], missingConstants[92])

runtimeState.remapThemeAccentColor = function(color)
    if typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then
        return nil
    end

    local result30 = math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5)
    local result31 = math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5)
    local result32 = math.floor(color.B * missingConstants[571] + 0.5)

    if
        result32 >= result31
            and result31 >= result30
            and result32 - result30 >= missingConstants[404]
        or result32 > result30
            and result30 <= missingConstants[709]
            and result31 <= missingConstants[707]
            and result32 <= missingConstants[750]
    then
        local combinedValue = result30 * missingConstants[110] + result31 * 0.45 + result32 * 0.33

        if runtimeState.settings2 and runtimeState.settings2.kiraTheme then
            return runtimeState.getKiraThemeGradient(combinedValue)
        end

        if runtimeState.settings2 and runtimeState.settings2.kingCrimsonTheme then
            return runtimeState.getKingCrimsonThemeGradient(combinedValue)
        end

        if runtimeState.settings2 and runtimeState.settings2.t636k9Theme then
            return runtimeState.getAlternateThemeGradient(combinedValue)
        end

        return runtimeState.getGrayscaleThemeColor(combinedValue)
    end

    return nil
end

        end

runtimeState.sanitizeSkinModel = function(object)
    local Parent4 = object

    while true do
        if not Parent4 then
            pcall(function()
                if object:IsA(missingConstants[729]) then
                    object.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
                    object.MaterialVariant = ""
                    object.Reflectance = 0
                    object.CastShadow = false
                    pcall(function()
                        object.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                        object.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                        object.FrontSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                        object.BackSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                        object.LeftSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                        object.RightSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                    end)

                    if object:IsA(missingConstants[400]) then
                        object.TextureID = ""
                    end
                elseif
                    object:IsA(missingConstants[524])
                    or object:IsA(missingConstants[251])
                    or object:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")
                then
                    object:Destroy()
                elseif object:IsA(missingConstants[245]) then
                    object:Destroy()
                else
                    if
                        object:IsA("Pants")
                        or object:IsA(missingConstants[9])
                        or object:IsA(missingConstants[264])
                    then
                        object:Destroy()

                        return
                    end

                    if object:IsA(missingConstants[199]) then
                        object.TextureId = ""
                    elseif
                        object:IsA(missingConstants[242])
                        or object:IsA("Trail")
                        or object:IsA(missingConstants[68])
                        or object:IsA(missingConstants[623])
                        or object:IsA(missingConstants[83])
                        or object:IsA("Sparkles")
                    then
                        object.Enabled = false
                    elseif
                        object:IsA("PointLight")
                        or object:IsA("SpotLight")
                        or object:IsA(missingConstants[27])
                    then
                        object.Enabled = missingConstants[357]
                    elseif object:IsA(missingConstants[632]) then
                        object.Enabled = missingConstants[357]
                    elseif
                        object:IsA("AnimationController") or object:IsA(missingConstants[102])
                    then
                        for _47, value32 in ipairs(object:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                            pcall(function()
                                value32:Stop(0)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            return
        end

        local textValue2 = tostring(Parent4.Name)

        if
            textValue2 ~= missingConstants[600]
            and textValue2 ~= "ChargeSoundPart"
            and textValue2 ~= "CraftingMachine"
            and textValue2 ~= "DO_NOT_REMOVE_ForgeTextureCache"
        then
            Parent4 = Parent4.Parent

            continue
        end

        break
    end

    return
end

application.controller.startLowGraphics = function()
    if runtimeState.isEnabled19 then
        return
    end

    runtimeState.isEnabled19 = missingConstants[577]
    runtimeState.settings2.lowGraphicsEnabled = true
    _G.EvadeDuelsPotatoGraphics = missingConstants[577]
    pcall(function()
        settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local worldAppearanceService2 = game:GetService(missingConstants[165])

        worldAppearanceService2.GlobalShadows = missingConstants[357]
        worldAppearanceService2.Brightness = missingConstants[711]
        worldAppearanceService2.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = missingConstants[182]
        worldAppearanceService2.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
        worldAppearanceService2.FogEnd = missingConstants[228]
        worldAppearanceService2.ShadowSoftness = 0

        for _48, child9 in ipairs(worldAppearanceService2:GetChildren()) do
            if
                child9:IsA("BlurEffect")
                or child9:IsA(missingConstants[702])
                or child9:IsA(missingConstants[12])
                or child9:IsA(missingConstants[533])
                or child9:IsA(missingConstants[687])
            then
                child9.Enabled = missingConstants[357]
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local Terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")

        if Terrain then
            Terrain.Decoration = false
            Terrain.WaterWaveSize = missingConstants[182]
            Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
            Terrain.WaterReflectance = missingConstants[182]
            Terrain.WaterTransparency = 1
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        local result105 = missingConstants[182]

        for _49, descendant12 in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if not runtimeState.isEnabled19 then
                return
            end

            runtimeState.sanitizeSkinModel(descendant12)
            result105 += 1

            if result105 % 350 == 0 then
                task.wait()
            end
        end
    end)

    if runtimeState.signalConnection3 then
        runtimeState.signalConnection3:Disconnect()
    end

    runtimeState.signalConnection3 = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant13)
        if runtimeState.isEnabled19 then
            runtimeState.sanitizeSkinModel(descendant13)
        end
    end)
end

application.controller.stopLowGraphics = function()
    runtimeState.isEnabled19 = missingConstants[357]
    runtimeState.settings2.lowGraphicsEnabled = missingConstants[357]
    _G.EvadeDuelsPotatoGraphics = missingConstants[357]

    if runtimeState.signalConnection3 then
        runtimeState.signalConnection3:Disconnect()
        runtimeState.signalConnection3 = nil
    end

    pcall(function()
        while true do
            settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Automatic

            break
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local Terrain2 = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")

        if Terrain2 then
            Terrain2.Decoration = true
        end
    end)

    return
end

runtimeState.hideOriginalBatPart = function(record, object3)
    if runtimeState.isBatReplicaObject(object3) then
        return
    end

    if object3:IsA(missingConstants[729]) or object3:IsA("Decal") or object3:IsA("Texture") then
        if runtimeState.obj4[object3] == nil then
            pcall(function()
                runtimeState.obj4[object3] = object3.Transparency
            end)
        end

        record.hidden[object3] = missingConstants[577]
        pcall(function()
            object3.Transparency = missingConstants[711]
        end)
    end
end
runtimeState.restoreOriginalBatParts = function(record2)
    for key9 in pairs(record2.hidden) do
        local transparency2 = runtimeState.obj4[key9]

        if key9 and key9.Parent and transparency2 ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                key9.Transparency = transparency2
            end)
        end
    end

    record2.hidden = {}
end
runtimeState.inspectSkinPartName = function(object4, partName)
    local text13 = tostring(object4 and object4.Name or ""):lower()

    if partName.modelName then
        if text13 == tostring(partName.modelName):lower() then
            return true
        end
    end

    if partName.modelNames then
        for _50, modelName in ipairs(partName.modelNames) do
            if text13 == tostring(modelName):lower() then
                return missingConstants[577]
            end
        end
    end

    if not partName.modelMatch then
        return false
    end

    for _51, value33 in ipairs(partName.modelMatch) do
        if text13:find(tostring(value33):lower(), missingConstants[711], missingConstants[577]) then
            continue
        end

        return missingConstants[357]
    end

    return missingConstants[577]
end
runtimeState.entries13 = {}
runtimeState.getPrimarySkinModel = function(asset)
    if not asset then
        return nil
    end

    if typeof(asset) ~= missingConstants[504] then
        return nil
    end

    if asset:IsA(missingConstants[753]) then
        if asset:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(missingConstants[729], missingConstants[577]) then
            return asset
        end

        return nil
    end

    local Model = Instance.new("Model")

    Model.Name = "LoadedBatSkinModel"

    if asset:IsA(missingConstants[729]) then
        asset.Parent = Model

        return Model
    end

    if asset:IsA("Folder") or asset:IsA("Configuration") then
        for _52, child10 in ipairs(asset:GetChildren()) do
            child10.Parent = Model
        end

        asset:Destroy()

        if Model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", missingConstants[577]) then
            return Model
        end

        Model:Destroy()

        return nil
    end

    if asset:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(missingConstants[729], true) then
        for _53, child11 in ipairs(asset:GetChildren()) do
            child11.Parent = Model
        end

        asset:Destroy()

        if Model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(missingConstants[729], true) then
            return Model
        end

        Model:Destroy()
    end

    return nil
end

runtimeState.resolveSkinCollectionItem = function(objects2, options5)
    if not objects2 or not objects2[missingConstants[711]] then
        return nil
    end

    if options5 and options5.modelChildName and #objects2 == missingConstants[711] then
        local result106 = objects2[missingConstants[711]]
        local result107 = result106
            and result106:FindFirstChild(options5.modelChildName, missingConstants[577])

        if
            result107
            and result107:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(missingConstants[729], missingConstants[577])
        then
            return runtimeState.getPrimarySkinModel(result107)
        end
    end

    if #objects2 == missingConstants[711] then
        return runtimeState.getPrimarySkinModel(objects2[1])
    end

    local parent12 = Instance.new(missingConstants[753])

    parent12.Name = missingConstants[155]

    for _54, value34 in ipairs(objects2) do
        if typeof(value34) == missingConstants[504] then
            value34.Parent = parent12
        end
    end

    if parent12:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(missingConstants[729], missingConstants[577]) then
        return parent12
    end

    parent12:Destroy()

    return nil
end
runtimeState.loadSkinAssetModel = function(skinConfig)
    local modelAssetId = skinConfig.modelAssetId or skinConfig.assetId

    if not modelAssetId then
        return nil
    end

    local textValue3 = tostring(modelAssetId)

    if tonumber(textValue3) then
        textValue3 = "rbxassetid://" .. textValue3
    end

    if
        runtimeState.entries13[textValue3]
        and runtimeState.entries13[textValue3].Parent ~= missingConstants[357]
    then
        return runtimeState.entries13[textValue3]
    end

    local objects

    if game.GetObjects then
        pcall(function()
            objects = game:GetObjects(textValue3)
        end)
    end

    if not objects or not objects[1] then
        local numericValue3 = tonumber(textValue3:match("%d+"))

        if numericValue3 then
            pcall(function()
                objects = { game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(numericValue3) }
            end)
        end
    end

    local result108 = runtimeState.resolveSkinCollectionItem(objects, skinConfig)

    if not result108 then
        return
    end

    runtimeState.entries13[textValue3] = result108

    return result108
end
runtimeState.findSkinModelInWorld = function(skinName)
    local entries14 = {
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"),
        workspace,
    }
    local skinAssetModel = runtimeState.loadSkinAssetModel(skinName)

    if skinAssetModel then
        return skinAssetModel
    end

    if skinName.modelName then
        for _55, value35 in ipairs(entries14) do
            local result109 = value35:FindFirstChild(skinName.modelName, true)

            if
                result109
                and result109:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(missingConstants[729], missingConstants[577])
            then
                return result109
            end
        end
    end

    if skinName.modelNames then
        for _56, modelName2 in ipairs(skinName.modelNames) do
            for _57, value36 in ipairs(entries14) do
                local result110 = value36:FindFirstChild(modelName2, true)

                if
                    result110
                    and result110:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
                        missingConstants[729],
                        missingConstants[577]
                    )
                then
                    return result110
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _58, value37 in ipairs(entries14) do
        for _59, descendant14 in ipairs(value37:GetDescendants()) do
            if
                (descendant14:IsA("Model") or descendant14:IsA(missingConstants[651]))
                and runtimeState.inspectSkinPartName(descendant14, skinName)
                and descendant14:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
                    missingConstants[729],
                    missingConstants[577]
                )
            then
                return descendant14
            end
        end
    end
end

runtimeState.prepareSkinModel = function(skinModel, options6)
    local options62 = options6
    local combinedValue32 = missingConstants[182]

    for _60, descendant15 in ipairs(skinModel:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant15:IsA(missingConstants[729]) then
            local Size = descendant15.Size
            local combinedValue3 = math.max(Size.X, Size.Y, Size.Z) * missingConstants[176]
                + Size.X * Size.Y * Size.Z

            if combinedValue32 < combinedValue3 then
                options62 = descendant15
                combinedValue32 = combinedValue3
            end
        end
    end

    return options62 or options6
end

runtimeState.setSkinEffectsEnabled = function(skinModel2, isEnabled4)
    if not skinModel2 then
        return
    end

    for _61, descendant16 in ipairs(skinModel2:GetDescendants()) do
        pcall(function()
            if
                descendant16:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                or descendant16:IsA(missingConstants[506])
                or descendant16:IsA("Beam")
                or descendant16:IsA("Fire")
                or descendant16:IsA("Smoke")
                or descendant16:IsA(missingConstants[359])
            then
                descendant16.Enabled = missingConstants[577]
            elseif
                descendant16:IsA(missingConstants[730])
                or descendant16:IsA("SpotLight")
                or descendant16:IsA("SurfaceLight")
            then
                descendant16.Enabled = true
            elseif descendant16:IsA(missingConstants[415]) then
                descendant16.Enabled = missingConstants[577]
            elseif descendant16:IsA("Sound") and isEnabled4 and isEnabled4.muteSounds then
                descendant16:Stop()
                descendant16.Playing = false
                descendant16.Volume = missingConstants[182]
            elseif
                (descendant16:IsA(missingConstants[631]) or descendant16:IsA(missingConstants[700]))
                and isEnabled4
                and isEnabled4.enableEffectScripts
            then
                descendant16.Disabled = missingConstants[357]
            end
        end)
    end

    if not skinModel2:GetAttribute(missingConstants[558]) then
        skinModel2:SetAttribute("WaveFxDescHooked", missingConstants[577])
        pcall(function()
            skinModel2.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant17)
                task.defer(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        if
                            descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[242])
                            or descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[506])
                            or descendant17:IsA("Beam")
                            or descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[623])
                            or descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[83])
                            or descendant17:IsA("Sparkles")
                        then
                            descendant17.Enabled = true
                        elseif
                            descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[730])
                            or descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[451])
                            or descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[27])
                        then
                            descendant17.Enabled = missingConstants[577]
                        elseif descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[415]) then
                            descendant17.Enabled = true
                        elseif
                            descendant17:IsA("Sound")
                            and isEnabled4
                            and isEnabled4.muteSounds
                        then
                            descendant17:Stop()
                            descendant17.Playing = missingConstants[357]
                            descendant17.Volume = missingConstants[182]
                        elseif
                            (
                                descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[631])
                                or descendant17:IsA(missingConstants[700])
                            )
                            and isEnabled4
                            and isEnabled4.enableEffectScripts
                        then
                            descendant17.Disabled = missingConstants[357]
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end
end

        )
        ParticleEmitter3.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({

            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, missingConstants[711]),
        })
        ParticleEmitter3.Size = NumberSequence.new({

        })
        ParticleEmitter3.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(missingConstants[649], missingConstants[646])
        ParticleEmitter3.Rate = missingConstants[138]
        ParticleEmitter3.Speed = NumberRange.new(missingConstants[697], missingConstants[599])
        ParticleEmitter3.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, missingConstants[324])
        ParticleEmitter3.Rotation = NumberRange.new(missingConstants[182], 360)
        ParticleEmitter3.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-60, missingConstants[324])
        ParticleEmitter3.LightEmission = 0.42
        ParticleEmitter3.Enabled = true
        ParticleEmitter3.Parent = parent14
    end
end

runtimeState.removeRestrictedSkinEffects = function(skinModel4)
    if not skinModel4 then
        return
    end

    if
        skinModel4:GetAttribute(missingConstants[683])
        and skinModel4:GetAttribute(missingConstants[326])
    then
        return
    end

    skinModel4:SetAttribute(missingConstants[683], true)

    local function isRestrictedSkinEffect(object5)
        if
            object5:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
            or object5:IsA(missingConstants[506])
            or object5:IsA(missingConstants[68])
            or object5:IsA("PointLight")
            or object5:IsA("SpotLight")
            or object5:IsA(missingConstants[27])
            or object5:IsA(missingConstants[415])
            or object5:IsA(missingConstants[623])
            or object5:IsA(missingConstants[83])
            or object5:IsA(missingConstants[359])
        then
            object5.Enabled = missingConstants[577]
        elseif object5:IsA("LocalScript") or object5:IsA(missingConstants[700]) then
            object5.Disabled = missingConstants[577]
        elseif object5:IsA("Sound") then
            object5:Stop()
            object5.Playing = false
            object5.Volume = 0
        end
    end

    for _65, descendant20 in ipairs(skinModel4:GetDescendants()) do
        if
            descendant20.Name == missingConstants[644]
            or descendant20.Name == missingConstants[678]
            or descendant20.Name == "WaveTanjiroFlame"
            or descendant20.Name == "WaveTanjiroEmbers"
            or descendant20.Name == missingConstants[107]
            or descendant20.Name == "WaveTanjiroVfxTrail"
            or descendant20.Name == "WaveTanjiroTrailA"
            or descendant20.Name == "WaveTanjiroTrailB"
        then
            pcall(function()
                descendant20:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            isRestrictedSkinEffect(descendant20)
        end)
    end

    if not skinModel4:GetAttribute(missingConstants[21]) then
        skinModel4:SetAttribute("WaveTanjiroStableHooked", true)
        pcall(function()
            skinModel4.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant21)
                task.defer(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        if
                            descendant21.Name == missingConstants[644]
                            or descendant21.Name == "WaveTanjiroSlash"
                            or descendant21.Name == missingConstants[715]
                            or descendant21.Name == "WaveTanjiroEmbers"
                            or descendant21.Name == "WaveTanjiroLight"
                            or descendant21.Name == missingConstants[144]
                            or descendant21.Name == "WaveTanjiroTrailA"
                            or descendant21.Name == "WaveTanjiroTrailB"
                        then
                            descendant21:Destroy()
                        else
                            isRestrictedSkinEffect(descendant21)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        skinModel4:SetAttribute("WaveTanjiroStableRunning", true)

        local counter6 = 0

        while skinModel4 do
            if skinModel4.Parent then
                counter6 = 0

                for _66, descendant22 in ipairs(skinModel4:GetDescendants()) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if
                            descendant22.Name == "WaveTanjiroMid"
                            or descendant22.Name == "WaveTanjiroSlash"
                        then
                            descendant22:Destroy()
                        elseif
                            descendant22.Name == missingConstants[715]
                            or descendant22.Name == "WaveTanjiroEmbers"
                            or descendant22.Name == missingConstants[107]
                            or descendant22.Name == "WaveTanjiroVfxTrail"
                            or descendant22.Name == "WaveTanjiroTrailA"
                            or descendant22.Name == "WaveTanjiroTrailB"
                        then
                            descendant22:Destroy()

                            return
                        else
                            isRestrictedSkinEffect(descendant22)
                        end
                    end)
                end

                task.wait(0.05)

                continue
            end

            counter6 += missingConstants[711]

            if not (missingConstants[671] < counter6) then
                task.wait(0.05)

                continue
            end

            break
        end

        pcall(function()
            if skinModel4 then
                skinModel4:SetAttribute("WaveTanjiroStableRunning", false)
            end
        end)
    end)
end
runtimeState.buildBatReplica = function(skinConfig4)
    local skinModelInWorld = runtimeState.findSkinModelInWorld(skinConfig4)

    if not skinModelInWorld then
        local fallbackSkinModel, result113 = runtimeState.createFallbackSkinModel(skinConfig4)

        if skinConfig4.fx == missingConstants[308] then
            pcall(function()
                runtimeState.applyGlacialSkinEffects(fallbackSkinModel, result113)

                return
            end)
        end

        return fallbackSkinModel, result113
    end

    local clone = skinModelInWorld:Clone()

    clone.Name = "LocalReplica"

    if skinConfig4.preserveAssetFx then
        clone:SetAttribute(missingConstants[637], true)
    end

    if skinConfig4.modelScale and clone.ScaleTo then
        pcall(function()
            clone:ScaleTo(skinConfig4.modelScale)

            return
        end)
    end

    local primaryPartName = skinConfig4.primaryPartName
            and clone:FindFirstChild(skinConfig4.primaryPartName, missingConstants[577])
        or clone.PrimaryPart
        or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", missingConstants[577])

    if not primaryPartName then
        clone:Destroy()

        return nil, nil
    end

    pcall(function()
        clone.PrimaryPart = primaryPartName
    end)

    for _67, descendant23 in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant23:IsA(missingConstants[729]) then
            descendant23.Anchored = false
            descendant23.CanCollide = false
            descendant23.CanTouch = false
            descendant23.CanQuery = missingConstants[357]
            descendant23.Massless = true

            if descendant23 ~= primaryPartName then
                local result114 = Instance.new(missingConstants[439])

                result114.Part0 = primaryPartName
                result114.Part1 = descendant23
                result114.Parent = primaryPartName
            end
        end

        if descendant23:IsA(missingConstants[321]) then
            pcall(function()
                descendant23:Stop()
                descendant23.Playing = false
                descendant23.Volume = missingConstants[182]
            end)
        end
    end

    if skinConfig4.preserveAssetFx and skinConfig4.fx ~= missingConstants[217] then
        pcall(function()
            runtimeState.setSkinEffectsEnabled(clone, skinConfig4)
        end)
    end

    if skinConfig4.fx == "glacial" then
        pcall(function()
            runtimeState.applyGlacialSkinEffects(clone, primaryPartName)

            return
        end)
    elseif skinConfig4.fx == missingConstants[217] then
        pcall(function()
            runtimeState.removeRestrictedSkinEffects(clone)
        end)
    end

    return clone, primaryPartName
end

runtimeState.attachBatReplica = function(tool2, skinConfig5)
    local LocalReplica = tool2:FindFirstChild("LocalReplica")

    if LocalReplica then
        LocalReplica:Destroy()
    end

    local Keyblade = runtimeState.waveBatSkinAssets[skinConfig5]
        or runtimeState.waveBatSkinAssets.Keyblade

    if
        Keyblade.modelAssetId
        or Keyblade.assetId
        or Keyblade.modelName
        or Keyblade.modelNames
        or Keyblade.modelMatch
    then
        local result115, part12 = runtimeState.buildBatReplica(Keyblade)

        if result115 and part12 then
            local result116 = Instance.new(missingConstants[207])

            result116.Part0 = tool2
            result116.Part1 = part12
            result116.C0 = Keyblade.c0 or CFrame.new()
            result116.Parent = part12
            result115.Parent = tool2

            if Keyblade.preserveAssetFx then
                pcall(function()
                    if Keyblade.fx == "tanjiro" then
                        runtimeState.removeRestrictedSkinEffects(result115)
                    else
                        runtimeState.setSkinEffectsEnabled(result115, Keyblade)
                    end
                end)
            end

            return result115
        end

        Keyblade = runtimeState.waveBatSkinAssets.Keyblade
    end

    local localReplica = Instance.new(missingConstants[753])

    localReplica.Name = "LocalReplica"

    local Part = Instance.new("Part")

    Part.Name = "MainPart"
    Part.CanCollide = false
    Part.CanQuery = false
    Part.CanTouch = missingConstants[357]
    Part.Massless = missingConstants[577]
    Part.Size = Vector3.new(missingConstants[711], missingConstants[711], 1)
    Part.Transparency = 0
    Part.Anchored = missingConstants[357]
    Part.Parent = localReplica

    local result117 = Instance.new(missingConstants[199])

    result117.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
    result117.MeshId = Keyblade.mesh
    result117.TextureId = Keyblade.tex
    result117.Scale = Keyblade.scale
    result117.Parent = Part

    local Motor6D = Instance.new("Motor6D")

    Motor6D.Part0 = tool2
    Motor6D.Part1 = Part
    Motor6D.C0 = Keyblade.c0
    Motor6D.Parent = Part
    localReplica.Parent = tool2

    return localReplica
end

application.applyBatSkin = function(tool3)
    if runtimeState.obj[tool3] then
        return
    end

    local Handle = tool3:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    local hiddenSettings

    if Handle then
        hiddenSettings = {
            hidden = {},
            conns = {},
        }
        runtimeState.obj[tool3] = hiddenSettings

        for _68, descendant24 in ipairs(tool3:GetDescendants()) do
            runtimeState.hideOriginalBatPart(hiddenSettings, descendant24)
        end
    else
        if runtimeState.obj3[tool3] then
            return
        end

        local signalConnection6

        signalConnection6 = tool3.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child12)
            if child12.Name == "Handle" then
                pcall(function()
                    signalConnection6:Disconnect()
                end)
                runtimeState.obj3[tool3] = nil

                if _G.WaveBatSkinEnabled then
                    application.applyBatSkin(tool3)
                end
            end
        end)
        runtimeState.obj3[tool3] = signalConnection6

        return
    end

    runtimeState.attachBatReplica(Handle, runtimeState.getSelectedBatSkinConfig())
    table.insert(
        hiddenSettings.conns,
        tool3.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant25)
            task.defer(function()
                if runtimeState.obj[tool3] then
                    runtimeState.hideOriginalBatPart(hiddenSettings, descendant25)
                end
            end)
        end)
    )
    table.insert(
        hiddenSettings.conns,
        tool3.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child13, parent)
            if not parent then
                runtimeState.refreshBatAppearance(tool3, false)
            end
        end)
    )
end
runtimeState.refreshBatAppearance = function(tool4, options7)
    local result118 = runtimeState.obj[tool4]

    if not result118 then
        return
    end

    for _69, conn in ipairs(result118.conns) do
        pcall(function()
            conn:Disconnect()
        end)
    end

    local Handle2 = tool4:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    local handle = Handle2 and Handle2:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[442])

    if handle then
        pcall(function()
            handle:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    if options7 then
        runtimeState.restoreOriginalBatParts(result118)
    end

    runtimeState.obj[tool4] = nil
end

runtimeState.refreshBatCharacter = function(character8)
    if not _G.WaveBatSkinEnabled then
        return
    end

    runtimeState.connectBatInventory()

    local Backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

    if Backpack then
        for _72, child16 in ipairs(Backpack:GetChildren()) do
            runtimeState.onBatDescendantAdded(child16)
        end
    end

    local Character14 = LocalPlayer.Character

    if Character14 then
        for _73, child17 in ipairs(Character14:GetChildren()) do
            runtimeState.onBatDescendantAdded(child17)
        end
    end

    for key10, value38 in pairs(runtimeState.obj) do
        if key10.Parent then
            local Handle3 = key10:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            local handle2 = Handle3 and Handle3:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[442])
            local PrimaryPart = handle2
                and (
                    handle2:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[437])
                    or handle2.PrimaryPart
                    or handle2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(missingConstants[729], missingConstants[577])
                )
            local primaryPart = PrimaryPart
                and PrimaryPart:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[207])

            if
                Handle3
                and (
                    not handle2
                    or not PrimaryPart
                    or not primaryPart
                    or primaryPart.Part0 ~= Handle3
                )
            then
                runtimeState.attachBatReplica(Handle3, runtimeState.getSelectedBatSkinConfig())
            end

            if character8 then
                for _74, descendant26 in ipairs(key10:GetDescendants()) do
                    runtimeState.hideOriginalBatPart(value38, descendant26)
                end
            end
        else
            runtimeState.refreshBatAppearance(key10, missingConstants[357])
        end
    end
end

    end

    end
end)

                return
            end)
        end

        table.clear(runtimeState.obj3)

        for key14 in pairs(runtimeState.obj2) do
            runtimeState.disconnectBatContainer(key14)
        end
    end
end

        if result121 then
            pcall(runtimeState.attachBatReplica, result121, waveBatSkinSelected)
        end
    end

    runtimeState.persistCurrentSettings()
end

        return
    end

    local signalConnection10

    signalConnection10 = tool6.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child20)
        if child20.Name == "Handle" then
            pcall(function()
                signalConnection10:Disconnect()

    runtimeState.obj32[tool6] = signalConnection10

runtimeState.refreshMedusaCharacter = function(character92)
    if not _G.WaveMedusaSkinEnabled then
        return
    end

    runtimeState.connectMedusaInventory()

    local result127 = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[745])

    if result127 then
        for _81, child24 in ipairs(result127:GetChildren()) do
            runtimeState.onMedusaDescendantAdded(child24)
        end
    end

    local Character15 = LocalPlayer.Character

    if Character15 then
        for _82, child25 in ipairs(Character15:GetChildren()) do
            runtimeState.onMedusaDescendantAdded(child25)
        end
    end

    for key17, value39 in pairs(runtimeState.obj5) do
        if key17.Parent then
            local result128 = key17:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[480])
            local result129 = result128 and result128:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[442])
            local PrimaryPart2 = result129

            if PrimaryPart2 then
                PrimaryPart2 = result129:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[437])
                    or result129.PrimaryPart
                PrimaryPart2 = PrimaryPart2
                    or result129:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
                        missingConstants[729],
                        missingConstants[577]
                    )
            end

            local Motor6D3 = PrimaryPart2 and PrimaryPart2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Motor6D")

            if
                result128
                and (
                    not result129
                    or not PrimaryPart2
                    or not Motor6D3
                    or Motor6D3.Part0 ~= result128
                )
            then
                runtimeState.createModel(result128, runtimeState.getSelectedMedusaSkinConfig())
            end

            if character92 then
                for _83, descendant29 in ipairs(key17:GetDescendants()) do
                    runtimeState.hideOriginalMedusaPart(value39, descendant29)
                end
            end
        else
            runtimeState.refreshMedusaAppearance(key17, false)
        end
    end
end

LocalPlayer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child26)
    if _G.WaveMedusaSkinEnabled and child26:IsA("Backpack") then
        runtimeState.connectMedusaContainer(child26)
    end
end)
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character10)
    for key18 in pairs(runtimeState.obj5) do
        runtimeState.refreshMedusaAppearance(key18, false)
    end

    for _84, signalConnection12 in pairs(runtimeState.obj32) do
        pcall(function()
            signalConnection12:Disconnect()
        end)
    end

    table.clear(runtimeState.obj32)

    for key19 in pairs(runtimeState.obj22) do
        runtimeState.disconnectMedusaContainer(key19)
    end

    if _G.WaveMedusaSkinEnabled then
        runtimeState.connectMedusaContainer(character10)
        task.defer(runtimeState.connectMedusaInventory)
        task.delay(missingConstants[120], function()
            pcall(runtimeState.refreshMedusaCharacter, true)
        end)
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local counter7 = 0

    while task.wait(0.4) do
        if _G.WaveMedusaSkinEnabled then
            counter7 += 1
            pcall(runtimeState.refreshMedusaCharacter, counter7 % missingConstants[681] == 0)
        end
    end
end)
_G.WaveMedusaSkinSetEnabled = function(value158)
    _G.WaveMedusaSkinEnabled = value158 == missingConstants[577]

    if _G.WaveMedusaSkinEnabled then
        runtimeState.connectMedusaInventory()
        pcall(runtimeState.refreshMedusaCharacter, missingConstants[577])
    else
        local disconnectSkinConnection

        for key20 in pairs(runtimeState.obj5) do
            disconnectSkinConnection = missingConstants[577]
            runtimeState.refreshMedusaAppearance(key20, disconnectSkinConnection)
        end

        for _85, signalConnection13 in pairs(runtimeState.obj32) do
            disconnectSkinConnection = function()
                signalConnection13:Disconnect()
            end
            pcall(disconnectSkinConnection)
        end

        table.clear(runtimeState.obj32)

        for key21 in pairs(runtimeState.obj22) do
            runtimeState.disconnectMedusaContainer(key21)
        end
    end
end

    if not runtimeState.waveMedusaSkinAssets[waveMedusaSkinSelected] then
        return
    end

    _G.WaveMedusaSkinSelected = waveMedusaSkinSelected
    _G.WaveMedusaSkinSetEnabled(true)

    for key22 in pairs(runtimeState.obj5) do
        local result130 = key22:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[480])

        if result130 then
            pcall(runtimeState.createModel, result130, waveMedusaSkinSelected)
        end
    end

    runtimeState.persistCurrentSettings()
end

runtimeState.applySettingsPreset = function(preset)
    if preset.kiraBackground ~= nil then
        runtimeState.settings2.kiraBackground = preset.kiraBackground == true
    end

    if preset.kiraTheme ~= nil then
        runtimeState.settings2.kiraTheme = preset.kiraTheme == true
    end

    if preset.kingCrimsonTheme ~= nil then
        runtimeState.settings2.kingCrimsonTheme = preset.kingCrimsonTheme == true
    end

    if preset.t636k9Theme ~= nil then
        runtimeState.settings2.t636k9Theme = preset.t636k9Theme == true
    end

    if preset.normalSpeed then
        runtimeState.settings2.normalSpeed = preset.normalSpeed

        if runtimeState.normalSpeed then
            runtimeState.normalSpeed.Text = tostring(preset.normalSpeed)
        end
    end

    if preset.carrySpeed then
        runtimeState.settings2.carrySpeed = preset.carrySpeed

        if runtimeState.numericSettingInput then
            runtimeState.numericSettingInput.Text = tostring(preset.carrySpeed)
        end
    end

    if preset.laggerSpeed then
        runtimeState.settings2.laggerSpeed = preset.laggerSpeed

        if runtimeState.numericSettingInput2 then
            runtimeState.numericSettingInput2.Text = tostring(preset.laggerSpeed)
        end
    end

    if preset.laggerSpeed2 then
        runtimeState.settings2.laggerSpeed2 = preset.laggerSpeed2

        if runtimeState.laggerCarrySpeed then
            runtimeState.laggerCarrySpeed.Text = tostring(preset.laggerSpeed2)
        end
    end

    if preset.jumpPowerTap ~= nil then
        runtimeState.settings2.jumpPowerTap = tonumber(preset.jumpPowerTap)
            or runtimeState.settings2.jumpPowerTap
    end

    if preset.jumpPowerHold ~= nil then
        runtimeState.settings2.jumpPowerHold = tonumber(preset.jumpPowerHold)
            or runtimeState.settings2.jumpPowerHold
    end

    runtimeState.settings2.jumpMode = preset.jumpMode == missingConstants[55]
            and missingConstants[55]
        or "Tap"

    if application.controller.jumpModeBtnRef then
        application.controller.jumpModeBtnRef.Text = runtimeState.settings2.jumpMode
    end

    if application.controller.refreshJumpPowerBox then
        application.controller.refreshJumpPowerBox()
    end

    if preset.infJump ~= nil and application.controller.setInfJump then
        runtimeState.settings2.infJumpEnabled = preset.infJump
        application.controller.setInfJump(preset.infJump)
    end

    if preset.antiRagdollMode then
        runtimeState.settings2.antiRagdollMode = preset.antiRagdollMode == missingConstants[563]
                and "V2"
            or "V1"

        if application.controller.antiRagdollModeBtnRef then
            application.controller.antiRagdollModeBtnRef.Text =
                runtimeState.settings2.antiRagdollMode
        end
    end

    if preset.antiRagdoll ~= nil then
        if application.controller.setAntiRag then
            runtimeState.settings2.antiRagdollEnabled = preset.antiRagdoll
            application.controller.setAntiRag(preset.antiRagdoll)

            if preset.antiRagdoll then
                application.controller.sAR()
            else
                application.controller.xAR()
            end
        end
    end

    if preset.antiLag ~= nil and application.controller.setAntiLag then
        runtimeState.settings2.antiLagEnabled = preset.antiLag
        application.controller.setAntiLag(preset.antiLag)

        if preset.antiLag then
            application.controller.startAntiLag()
        else
            application.controller.stopAntiLag()
        end
    end

    if preset.lowGraphics ~= nil and application.controller.setLowGraphics then
        runtimeState.settings2.lowGraphicsEnabled = preset.lowGraphics
        application.controller.setLowGraphics(preset.lowGraphics)

        if preset.lowGraphics and application.controller.startLowGraphics then
            application.controller.startLowGraphics()
        elseif not preset.lowGraphics and application.controller.stopLowGraphics then
            application.controller.stopLowGraphics()
        end
    end

    runtimeState.settings2.antiDesyncEnabled = missingConstants[357]

    if application.controller.setAntiDesyncToggle then
        application.controller.setAntiDesyncToggle(false)
    else
        application.controller.stopAntiDesync()
    end

    if preset.stretchRez ~= nil and application.controller.setStretchRez then
        runtimeState.settings2.stretchRezEnabled = preset.stretchRez
        application.controller.setStretchRez(preset.stretchRez)

    end

    if preset.removeAccessories ~= nil and application.controller.setRemoveAccessories then

            application.controller.startRemoveAccessories()
        else
            application.controller.stopRemoveAccessories()
        end
    end

    if preset.unwalkEnabled ~= nil and application.controller.setUnwalkToggle then

        if preset.unwalkEnabled then
            application.controller.stopUnwalk()
            application.controller.startUnwalk()
        else
            application.controller.stopUnwalk()
        end

    if preset.slumAnimEnabled ~= nil and application.controller.setSlumAnimToggle then

    if preset.medusaCounter ~= nil and application.controller.setMedusaCounter then

    if preset.batAimbotSpeed then

application.controller._panelCreateLaggerPanel = function()
    local isActive10 = missingConstants[357]
    local thread3
    local lowSettings = {
        Low = missingConstants[212],
        Mid = missingConstants[166],
        High = 260,
        Ultra = missingConstants[137],
    }

    local function captureReplicationObjects(objects3)
        local entries20 = {}
        local entries21 = { {} }
        local entries222 = entries21[1]
        local Ultra = lowSettings[objects3] or lowSettings.Ultra

        for i12 = missingConstants[711], Ultra do
            local entries22 = {}

            table.insert(entries222, entries22)
            entries222 = entries22
        end

        for i13 = missingConstants[711], math.min(missingConstants[273] / (Ultra + missingConstants[62]), 1500) do
            table.insert(entries20, entries21)
        end

        pcall(function()
            game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
            game:GetService("RobloxReplicatedStorage").SetPlayerBlockList:FireServer(entries20)
        end)

        return
    end

    local waveLagger = runtimeState.createMobileFeatureWindow(
        "WAVE LAGGER",
        runtimeState.G,
        function(value185)
            isActive10 = value185

            if value185 then
                thread3 = task.spawn(function()
                    while isActive10 do
                        local _waveLaggerPower2 = application.controller._waveLaggerPower
                            or missingConstants[503]

                        task.spawn(function()
                            captureReplicationObjects(_waveLaggerPower2)
                        end)
                        task.wait(0.25)
                    end
                end)
            elseif thread3 then
                task.cancel(thread3)
                thread3 = nil
            end
        end,
        function(value186)
            runtimeState.G = value186
        end,
        missingConstants[257],
        missingConstants[577],
        _subLaggerPos
    )

    if waveLagger then
        waveLagger.Destroying:Connect(function()
            if thread3 then
                task.cancel(thread3)
                thread3 = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    return waveLagger
end

application.controller._waveGetAppliedMoveSpeed = function()
    local laggerSpeed

    if runtimeState.settings2.laggerEnabled and runtimeState.settings2.laggerVariant == 1 then
        laggerSpeed = runtimeState.settings2.laggerSpeed
    elseif
        runtimeState.settings2.laggerEnabled
        and runtimeState.settings2.laggerVariant == missingConstants[62]
    then
        laggerSpeed = runtimeState.settings2.laggerSpeed2
    else
        laggerSpeed = (runtimeState.settings2.speedToggled or _waveAutoCarryActive())
                and runtimeState.settings2.carrySpeed
            or runtimeState.settings2.normalSpeed
    end

    local clampedValue12 =
        math.clamp(tonumber(laggerSpeed) or runtimeState.settings2.normalSpeed or 0, 1, 4000)

    return clampedValue12
end
application.controller._wavePreserveTpDownSpeed = function(characterRoot7, value189)
    local Character16 = LocalPlayer.Character
    local character19 = Character16 and Character16:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[322])

    if not characterRoot7 then
        return
    end

    local MoveDirection = character19 and character19.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
    local isMatching10 = MoveDirection.Magnitude > missingConstants[718]
            and Vector3.new(MoveDirection.X, missingConstants[182], MoveDirection.Z)
        or runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir and runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir.Magnitude > 0.05 and Vector3.new(
            runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir.X,
            0,
            runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir.Z
        )
        or Vector3.new(value189.X, 0, value189.Z)

    if isMatching10.Magnitude <= 0.05 then
        return
    end

    local Unit = isMatching10.Unit
    local Y4 = characterRoot7.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
    local result177 = math.max(
        Vector3.new(value189.X, missingConstants[182], value189.Z).Magnitude,
        application.controller._waveGetAppliedMoveSpeed()
    )

    characterRoot7.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(Unit.X * result177, Y4, Unit.Z * result177)
    characterRoot7.Velocity = characterRoot7.AssemblyLinearVelocity
end

application.controller._holdWaveTpDownPosition = function(characterRoot8)
    if characterRoot8 then
        if
            not ((application.controller._waveTpDownActiveUntil or missingConstants[182]) <= tick())
        then
            local _waveTpDownTargetY = application.controller._waveTpDownTargetY

            if not _waveTpDownTargetY then
                return true
            end

            local value = select(2, characterRoot8.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ())

            if _waveTpDownTargetY + 0.15 < characterRoot8.Position.Y then
                characterRoot8.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    characterRoot8.Position.X,
                    _waveTpDownTargetY,
                    characterRoot8.Position.Z
                ) * CFrame.Angles(
                    missingConstants[182],
                    value,
                    missingConstants[182]
                )
            end

            local AssemblyLinearVelocity = characterRoot8.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local Y5 = AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y

            if -missingConstants[470] < Y5 then
                Y5 = -90
            end

            characterRoot8.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
                Vector3.new(AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, Y5, AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
            characterRoot8.Velocity = characterRoot8.AssemblyLinearVelocity

            return missingConstants[577]
        end
    end

    return false
end
application.controller.doTpDown = function()
    pcall(function()
        if
            tick() - (application.controller._lastManualTpDownAt or missingConstants[182]) < 0.12
        then
            return
        end

        application.controller._lastManualTpDownAt = tick()
        application.controller._markWaveTpDown(-7)

        local Character17 = LocalPlayer.Character

        if not Character17 then
            return
        end

        local characterRoot9 = Character17:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[497])

        if not characterRoot9 then
            return
        end

        if not Character17:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            return
        end

        local AssemblyLinearVelocity2 = characterRoot9.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local infJumpEnabled2 = runtimeState.settings2.infJumpEnabled
            and runtimeState.settings2.jumpMode == "Hold"
            and application.controller._waveJumpHeld
            and characterRoot9:FindFirstChild("WAVEJumpHoldLinearVelocity") ~= nil

        characterRoot9.CFrame = CFrame.new(
            characterRoot9.Position.X,
            -missingConstants[474],
            characterRoot9.Position.Z
        ) * CFrame.Angles(
            missingConstants[182],
            select(2, characterRoot9.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()),
            0
        )

        if infJumpEnabled2 then
            characterRoot9.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                AssemblyLinearVelocity2.X,
                math.max(
                    AssemblyLinearVelocity2.Y,
                    application.controller.getWaveJumpHoldSpeed
                            and application.controller.getWaveJumpHoldSpeed()
                        or missingConstants[554]
                ),
                AssemblyLinearVelocity2.Z
            )
        else
            characterRoot9.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                AssemblyLinearVelocity2.X,
                characterRoot9.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,
                AssemblyLinearVelocity2.Z
            )
        end

        application.controller._wavePreserveTpDownSpeed(characterRoot9, AssemblyLinearVelocity2)
    end)
end

    runtimeState.raycastParams = runtimeState.raycastParams or RaycastParams.new()
    runtimeState.raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    pcall(function()
        runtimeState.raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = true
    end)
    runtimeState.raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character20 }

    local hit = workspace:Raycast(
        character21.Position + Vector3.new(missingConstants[182], 0.35, missingConstants[182]),
        Vector3.new(missingConstants[182], -missingConstants[419], 0),
        runtimeState.raycastParams
    )

        runtimeState.signalConnection18:Disconnect()

    local function applyDropVelocity(characterRoot2, direction2)
        local AssemblyLinearVelocity4 = characterRoot2 and characterRoot2.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            or Vector3.zero
        local vector = Vector3.new(AssemblyLinearVelocity4.X, 0, AssemblyLinearVelocity4.Z)
        local MoveDirection2 = direction2 and direction2.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero

        if MoveDirection2.Magnitude > 0.03 then
            local _getDropResumeSpeed = application.controller._getDropResumeSpeed
                    and application.controller._getDropResumeSpeed()
                or runtimeState.settings2.speedToggled and runtimeState.settings2.carrySpeed
                or runtimeState.settings2.normalSpeed

                * math.clamp(
                    tonumber(_getDropResumeSpeed) or missingConstants[182],
                    missingConstants[182],
                    missingConstants[250]
                )
        end

        return Vector3.new(vector.X, 0, vector.Z)
    end
    local function connectDropCharacter(character102)

            runtimeState.signalConnection18:Disconnect()
            runtimeState.signalConnection18 = nil
        end

        end
    end

    local Backpack2 = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")

    if Backpack2 then
        for _120, child41 in ipairs(Backpack2:GetChildren()) do

    end

end
