runtimeState.estimateTargetVelocity = function(characterRoot3)
    if not characterRoot3 then
        return Vector3.zero
    end

    local now8 = tick()
    local Position34 = characterRoot3.Position
    local result182 = runtimeState.obj6[characterRoot3]
    local zero = Vector3.zero

    if result182 then
        local offset7 = now8 - result182.time

        if offset7 > 0.001 and offset7 < 0.25 then
            local offset8 = Position34 - result182.position

            zero = Vector3.new(offset8.X / offset7, offset8.Y / offset7, offset8.Z / offset7)
        end
    end

    local vector4 = Vector3.new(zero.X, missingConstants[182], zero.Z)

    if vector4.Magnitude > 240 then
        vector4 = vector4.Unit * 240
    end

    local X3 = vector4.X
    local clampedValue13 = math.clamp(zero.Y, -missingConstants[736], missingConstants[736])
    local Z2 = vector4.Z
    local velocity = Vector3.new(X3, clampedValue13, Z2)

    if result182 and result182.velocity then
        clampedValue13 = velocity
        Z2 = missingConstants[706]
        velocity = result182.velocity:Lerp(clampedValue13, Z2)
    end

    runtimeState.obj6[characterRoot3] = {
        position = Position34,
        time = now8,
        velocity = velocity,
    }

    return velocity
end

        + targetVelocity * 0.14
        + targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector * missingConstants[247]

runtimeState.updateMeleeTarget = function()
    local Character25 = LocalPlayer.Character
        and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[497])

    if not Character25 then
        return nil
    end

    for _121, player13 in ipairs(players2:GetPlayers()) do
        if player13 ~= LocalPlayer and player13.Character then
            local result184 = player13.Character:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[497])
            local Humanoid5 = player13.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if result184 and Humanoid5 and missingConstants[182] < Humanoid5.Health then
                local Magnitude2 = (result184.Position - Character25.Position).Magnitude

                if Magnitude2 < huge then
                    huge = Magnitude2
                    result183 = result184

            end
        end
    end

    return result183
end

application.controller._waveBatAimApplyMover = function(parent16, value191, value192, value193)
    if not parent16 then
        return
    end

        Attachment4.Name = application.controller._waveBatAimAttachmentName
        Attachment4.Parent = parent16

        result187.Attachment0 = Attachment4

            result187.ForceLimitsEnabled = missingConstants[577]
            result187.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
        end)

        result187.Parent = parent16
    end

        parent16.AssemblyMass
            * math.max((tonumber(value192) or missingConstants[182]) * missingConstants[668], 6000),
        missingConstants[106],
        missingConstants[172]

    end)

        value191,
        missingConstants[711]

runtimeState.findBatTool = function()
    local Character29 = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character29 then
        local result191 = missingConstants[192]

        return nil
    end

    local Backpack3 = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

    for _122, value56 in ipairs(runtimeState.entries24) do
        local backpack = Character29:FindFirstChild(value56)
            or Backpack3 and Backpack3:FindFirstChild(value56)

        if backpack then
            return backpack
        end
    end

    for _123, child43 in ipairs(Character29:GetChildren()) do
        if not child43:IsA("Tool") then
            continue
        end

        if child43.Name:lower():find("bat") then
            return child43
        end
    end

    if Backpack3 then
        for _124, child44 in ipairs(Backpack3:GetChildren()) do
            if not child44:IsA(missingConstants[484]) then
                continue
            end

            if child44.Name:lower():find("bat") then
                return child44
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

application.controller.startBatCounter = function()
    if runtimeState.antiRagSettings.batCounter then
        return
    end

    runtimeState.antiRagSettings.batCounter = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if
            not runtimeState.settings2.batCounterEnabled
            or runtimeState.settings2.batCounterDebounce
            or runtimeState.settings2.batAimbotToggled
            or runtimeState.settings2.antiDesyncEnabled
        then
            return
        end

        local Character31 = LocalPlayer.Character

        if not Character31 then
            return
        end

        local Humanoid9 = Character31:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if not Humanoid9 then
            return
        end

        local state = Humanoid9:GetState()

        if
            state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
        then
            runtimeState.settings2.batCounterDebounce = missingConstants[577]
            task.spawn(function()
                if
                    not (
                        runtimeState.settings2.batAimbotToggled
                        or runtimeState.settings2.antiDesyncEnabled
                    )
                then
                    if runtimeState.settings2.batCounterMode == "V2" then
                        application.controller.runBatCounterV2()
                    else
                        local batTool = runtimeState.findBatTool()

                        if batTool then
                            runtimeState.activateBatOnCharacter(batTool, Character31)
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(missingConstants[589])
                runtimeState.settings2.batCounterDebounce = false
            end)
        end
    end)
end

runtimeState.findMedusaTool = function()
    local Character33 = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character33 then
        return nil
    end

    for _129, child45 in ipairs(Character33:GetChildren()) do
        if not child45:IsA("Tool") then
            continue
        end

        local text15 = child45.Name:lower()

        if
            text15:find(missingConstants[57])
            or text15:find(missingConstants[146])
            or text15:find(missingConstants[46])
        then
            return child45
        end
    end

    local Backpack4 = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")

    if Backpack4 then
        for _130, child46 in ipairs(Backpack4:GetChildren()) do
            if not child46:IsA("Tool") then
                continue
            end

            local text16 = child46.Name:lower()

            if text16:find("medusa") or text16:find("head") or text16:find("stone") then
                return child46
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

runtimeState.activateMedusa = function()
    if runtimeState.settings2.medusaDebounce then
        return
    end

    if tick() - runtimeState.settings2.medusaLastUsed < 25 then
        return
    end

    local Character34 = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character34 then
        return
    end

    runtimeState.settings2.medusaDebounce = true

    local medusaTool = runtimeState.findMedusaTool()

    if not medusaTool then
        runtimeState.settings2.medusaDebounce = missingConstants[357]

        return
    end

    if medusaTool.Parent ~= Character34 then
        local result196 = Character34:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[322])

        if result196 then
            result196:EquipTool(medusaTool)
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        medusaTool:Activate()
    end)
    runtimeState.settings2.medusaLastUsed = tick()
    runtimeState.settings2.medusaDebounce = false
end

runtimeState.watchCharacterAnchoring = function(part2)
    do
        local signal = part2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored")

        local function handleAnchoringChanged()
            if part2.Anchored and part2.Transparency == 1 then
                runtimeState.activateMedusa()
            end
        end

        return signal:Connect(handleAnchoringChanged)
    end
end

application.controller.setupMedusaCounter = function(value194)
    application.controller.stopMedusaCounter()

    if not value194 then
        return
    end

    for _131, descendant34 in ipairs(value194:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant34:IsA(missingConstants[729]) then
            table.insert(
                runtimeState.antiRagSettings.anchor,
                runtimeState.watchCharacterAnchoring(descendant34)
            )
        end
    end

    table.insert(
        runtimeState.antiRagSettings.anchor,
        value194.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant35)
            if descendant35:IsA(missingConstants[729]) then
                table.insert(
                    runtimeState.antiRagSettings.anchor,
                    runtimeState.watchCharacterAnchoring(descendant35)
                )
            end
        end)
    )
end

        end)
    end

end

runtimeState.isPointerOverInterface = function(pointerPosition)
    if not runtimeState.result6 or not runtimeState.result6.Enabled then
        return missingConstants[357]
    end

    local function isMainInterfaceObject(guiObject2)
        return runtimeState.frame
                and (guiObject2 == runtimeState.frame or guiObject2:IsDescendantOf(
                    runtimeState.frame
                ))
            or application.controller._adBtnFrame
                and (guiObject2 == application.controller._adBtnFrame or guiObject2:IsDescendantOf(
                    application.controller._adBtnFrame
                ))
    end
    local function containsPointerPosition(guiObject3)
        if not guiObject3 or not guiObject3.Visible then
            return false
        end

        local AbsolutePosition = guiObject3.AbsolutePosition
        local AbsoluteSize2 = guiObject3.AbsoluteSize

        return pointerPosition.X >= AbsolutePosition.X
            and pointerPosition.X <= AbsolutePosition.X + AbsoluteSize2.X
            and pointerPosition.Y >= AbsolutePosition.Y
            and pointerPosition.Y <= AbsolutePosition.Y + AbsoluteSize2.Y
    end

    if
        containsPointerPosition(runtimeState.parent8)
        or containsPointerPosition(runtimeState.scrollingFrame)
    then
        return missingConstants[577]
    end

    local ok17, result200 = pcall(function()
        return LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(pointerPosition.X, pointerPosition.Y)
    end)

    if not ok17 or not result200 then
        return false
    end

    for _134, value57 in ipairs(result200) do
        if not value57:IsDescendantOf(runtimeState.result6) or isMainInterfaceObject(value57) then
            continue
        end

        return missingConstants[577]
    end

    return missingConstants[357]
end

runtimeState.hookCharacterVelocity = function(characterRoot4)
    if
        not characterRoot4
        or not getrawmetatable
        or not setreadonly
        or not newcclosure
        or not checkcaller
    then
        return
    end

    runtimeState.enabledSettings.hookedVelParts[characterRoot4] = true

    local velMt2 = getrawmetatable(characterRoot4)

    if not velMt2 then
        return
    end

    if
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookInstalled
        and runtimeState.enabledSettings.velMt == velMt2
    then
        return
    end

    setreadonly(velMt2, false)

    local velOriginalIndex = rawget(velMt2, missingConstants[468])

    runtimeState.enabledSettings.velOriginalIndex = velOriginalIndex
    runtimeState.enabledSettings.velMt = velMt2

    if type(velOriginalIndex) == missingConstants[235] then
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookFn = newcclosure(function(value198, value199)
            if
                value199 ~= "AssemblyLinearVelocity" and value199 ~= missingConstants[679]
                or not runtimeState.enabledSettings.spoofActive
                or not runtimeState.enabledSettings.velChecked[value198]
                or checkcaller()
            then
                return velOriginalIndex(value198, value199)
            end

            local result203 = velOriginalIndex(value198, value199)

            if typeof(result203) == missingConstants[52] then
                local Magnitude5 = result203.Magnitude

                if Magnitude5 > 20 then
                    return result203 * (missingConstants[278] / Magnitude5)
                end
            end

            return result203
        end)

        if runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookFn then
            velMt2.__index = runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookFn
            runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookInstalled = true
        end
    else
        if type(velOriginalIndex) == "table" then
            runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookFn = newcclosure(function(value200, value201)
                if
                    value201 ~= "AssemblyLinearVelocity" and value201 ~= missingConstants[679]
                    or not runtimeState.enabledSettings.spoofActive
                    or not runtimeState.enabledSettings.velChecked[value200]
                    or checkcaller()
                then
                    return velOriginalIndex[value201]
                end

                local result204 = velOriginalIndex[value201]

                if typeof(result204) == missingConstants[52] then
                    local Magnitude6 = result204.Magnitude

                    if Magnitude6 > 20 then
                        return result204 * (missingConstants[278] / Magnitude6)
                    end
                end

                return result204
            end)
        end

        if runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookFn then
            velMt2.__index = runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookFn
            runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookInstalled = true
            setreadonly(velMt2, missingConstants[577])

            return
        end
    end

    setreadonly(velMt2, missingConstants[577])
end

runtimeState.setMovementVelocitySpoofing = function(isEnabled9, characterRoot5)
    local spoofActive = isEnabled9 and missingConstants[577]

    spoofActive = spoofActive or missingConstants[357]

    if
        spoofActive == runtimeState.enabledSettings.spoofActive
        and (
            spoofActive and runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookInstalled
            or not spoofActive and not runtimeState.enabledSettings.velHookInstalled
        )
    then
        return
    end

    runtimeState.enabledSettings.spoofActive = spoofActive

    if runtimeState.enabledSettings.spoofActive then
        runtimeState.hookCharacterVelocity(characterRoot5)

        return

runtimeState.refreshMovementCharacter = function(character12)
    runtimeState.resetMovementState()

    local root2 = runtimeState.resolveCharacterMovementParts(character12)

    runtimeState.enabledSettings.char = character12
    runtimeState.enabledSettings.hum = character12
        and character12:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[322])
    runtimeState.enabledSettings.root = root2
    runtimeState.getActiveMovementSpeed()

runtimeState.updateMovementCharacter = function(deltaTime2, forceRefresh)
    local char = runtimeState.enabledSettings.char or LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum3 = runtimeState.enabledSettings.hum
        or char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[322])
    local root = runtimeState.enabledSettings.root
        or char and char:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[497])

    if not char or not hum3 or not root or hum3.Health <= missingConstants[182] then
        return
    end

    if deltaTime2 and missingConstants[718] < deltaTime2.Magnitude then
        local now9 = tick()

        if runtimeState.enabledSettings.netRoot == root then
            if (runtimeState.enabledSettings.netAt or missingConstants[182]) <= now9 then
                runtimeState.enabledSettings.netRoot = root
                runtimeState.enabledSettings.netAt = now9 + missingConstants[421]
                pcall(function()
                    if root.SetNetworkOwner then
                        root:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer)
                    end
                end)
            end
        else
            runtimeState.enabledSettings.netRoot = root
            runtimeState.enabledSettings.netAt = now9 + missingConstants[421]
            pcall(function()
                if root.SetNetworkOwner then
                    root:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer)
                end
            end)
        end

        local Unit6 = deltaTime2.Unit

        _G._WaveAntiBatDesiredXZ = Vector3.new(Unit6.X * forceRefresh, 0, Unit6.Z * forceRefresh)

        if not _G._WaveAntiBatSpiking then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                Unit6.X * forceRefresh,
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,
                Unit6.Z * forceRefresh
            )
        end

        runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir = Unit6
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveDir = Unit6
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveAt = tick()
    else
        _G._WaveAntiBatDesiredXZ = nil

        if not _G._WaveAntiBatSpiking then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
                Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, missingConstants[182])
        end
    end
end
runtimeState.isCharacterRagdolled = function(humanoid3)
    if not humanoid3 then
        return true
    end

    local state2 = humanoid3:GetState()

    return humanoid3.PlatformStand
        or state2 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
        or state2 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
        or state2 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
end
runtimeState.updateCustomMovement = function()
    local Character36 = LocalPlayer.Character

    if
        runtimeState.settings2.autoLeftEnabled
        or runtimeState.settings2.autoRightEnabled
        or runtimeState.settings2.batAimbotToggled
        or runtimeState.settings2.antiDesyncEnabled
    then
        runtimeState.setMovementVelocitySpoofing(false, runtimeState.enabledSettings.root)

        return
    end

    if
        Character36 ~= runtimeState.enabledSettings.char
        or not runtimeState.enabledSettings.hum
        or not runtimeState.enabledSettings.hum.Parent
        or not runtimeState.enabledSettings.root
        or not runtimeState.enabledSettings.root.Parent
    then
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.char = Character36
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.hum = Character36
            and Character36:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.root = Character36
            and Character36:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local hum4 = runtimeState.enabledSettings.hum
    local root3 = runtimeState.enabledSettings.root

    if not hum4 or not root3 then
        return
    end

    local now10 = tick()

    if (runtimeState.enabledSettings.spoofCarryAt or 0) <= now10 then
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.spoofCarryAt = now10 + 0.12
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.spoofCarry = safeIsCarrying() == true
    end

    runtimeState.setMovementVelocitySpoofing(
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.spoofCarry == missingConstants[577],
        root3
    )

    local isCharacterRagdolled2 = runtimeState.isCharacterRagdolled(hum4)
    local result205 = runtimeState.applyMovementVelocity(isCharacterRagdolled2)

    if isCharacterRagdolled2 then
        local lastMoveDir = result205

        if missingConstants[670] < lastMoveDir.Magnitude then
            runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveDir = lastMoveDir
            runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir = lastMoveDir
            runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveAt = tick()
        end

        return
    end

    local MoveDirection4 = result205

    if
        MoveDirection4.Magnitude <= missingConstants[670]
        and not runtimeState.controlModuleSettings.controlModule
    then
        MoveDirection4 = hum4.MoveDirection
    end

    local activeMovementSpeed = runtimeState.getActiveMovementSpeed()
    local Unit7

    if missingConstants[182] < MoveDirection4.Magnitude then
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveDir = MoveDirection4.Unit
        runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir = MoveDirection4.Unit
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveAt = tick()
        Unit7 = MoveDirection4.Unit
    elseif
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveDir.Magnitude > 0
        and missingConstants[670] < result205.Magnitude
    then
        Unit7 = runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveDir
    end

    if MoveDirection4.Magnitude <= missingConstants[670] then
        runtimeState.controlModuleSettings.lastLiveInput = Vector3.zero
    end

    runtimeState.updateMovementCharacter(Unit7, activeMovementSpeed)
end

                                        and runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir

                                    if mobileTouchDir then
                                        enabledSettings3 = runtimeState.enabledSettings
                                            and tonumber(runtimeState.enabledSettings.speed)
                                    else
                                        mobileTouchDir = nil
                                        enabledSettings3 = runtimeState.enabledSettings
                                            and tonumber(runtimeState.enabledSettings.speed)
                                    end
                                end

                                continue
                            end

                            if not (nil < nil) then
                                return (nil)()
                            end

                            if mobileTouchDir then
                                enabledSettings3 = runtimeState.enabledSettings
                                    and tonumber(runtimeState.enabledSettings.speed)

                                continue
                            end

                            mobileTouchDir = runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir
                                and runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir.Magnitude > 0.05
                                and runtimeState.enabledSettings

                            if mobileTouchDir then
                                now25 = tick()
                                lastMoveAt = runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveAt or 0
                                mobileTouchDir = now25 - lastMoveAt < 0.28
                            end

                            mobileTouchDir = mobileTouchDir and runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir

                            if mobileTouchDir then
                                enabledSettings3 = runtimeState.enabledSettings
                                    and tonumber(runtimeState.enabledSettings.speed)

                                continue
                            end

                            mobileTouchDir = nil
                        end

                        enabledSettings3 = runtimeState.enabledSettings
                            and tonumber(runtimeState.enabledSettings.speed)
                    end

                    return (nil)()
                end)
            end
        end)

        return
    end
end

runtimeState.modeSettings.CacheChar = function()

    if not Character42 then
        return false
    end

    local humanoid9 = Character42:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[322])

    if humanoid9 then

            runtimeState.modeSettings.Cache = {

                root = root32,
            }

            return missingConstants[577]
        end
    end

    return false
end

runtimeState.modeSettings.IsRagdolled = function()
    local humanoid = runtimeState.modeSettings.Cache.humanoid

    if not humanoid then
        return missingConstants[357]
    end

    local state6 = humanoid:GetState()

    if
        state6 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
        or state6 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
        or state6 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    then
        return true
    end

    local attribute3 = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(missingConstants[197])

    if attribute3 then
        if missingConstants[182] < attribute3 - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
            return true
        end
    end

    return missingConstants[357]
end

runtimeState.modeSettings.ForceExit = function()
    local Cache = runtimeState.modeSettings.Cache

    if not Cache.humanoid or not Cache.root or not Cache.character then
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("RagdollEndTime", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end)

    for _143, descendant43 in ipairs(Cache.character:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant43:IsA(missingConstants[86]) then
            pcall(function()
                descendant43:Destroy()
            end)
        elseif descendant43:IsA("Attachment") then
            if descendant43.Name:find(missingConstants[141]) then
                pcall(function()
                    descendant43:Destroy()
                end)

                continue
            end
        end
    end

    if runtimeState.modeSettings.Boosting then
        runtimeState.modeSettings.Boosting = missingConstants[357]
        Cache.humanoid.WalkSpeed = runtimeState.modeSettings.DefaultSpeed or missingConstants[650]
    end

    if missingConstants[182] < Cache.humanoid.Health then
        Cache.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
    end

    pcall(function()
        if workspace.CurrentCamera then
            workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Cache.humanoid
        end
    end)
    Cache.root.Anchored = missingConstants[357]

    local AssemblyLinearVelocity8 = Cache.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local MoveDirection5 = runtimeState.applyMovementVelocity(missingConstants[577])

    if MoveDirection5.Magnitude <= missingConstants[670] then
        MoveDirection5 = Cache.humanoid.MoveDirection
    end

    if
        MoveDirection5.Magnitude <= missingConstants[670]
        and runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir
        and runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir.Magnitude > 0.03
        and runtimeState.enabledSettings
    then
        if tick() - (runtimeState.enabledSettings.lastMoveAt or missingConstants[182]) < 0.45 then
            MoveDirection5 = runtimeState.settings2.lastMoveDir
        end
    end

    local activeMovementSpeed2 = runtimeState.getActiveMovementSpeed()
    local isMatching13 = (application.controller._waveTpDownActiveUntil or 0) > tick()

    if
        isMatching13
        and application.controller._holdWaveTpDownPosition
        and application.controller._holdWaveTpDownPosition(Cache.root)
    then
        return
    end

    local clampedValue19 = math.clamp(
        math.min(AssemblyLinearVelocity8.Y, missingConstants[182]),
        -missingConstants[541],
        0
    )
    local assemblyLinearVelocity3 = MoveDirection5.Magnitude > missingConstants[670]
            and Vector3.new(
                MoveDirection5.Unit.X * activeMovementSpeed2,
                clampedValue19,
                MoveDirection5.Unit.Z * activeMovementSpeed2
            )
        or Vector3.new(0, clampedValue19, 0)

    if runtimeState.enabledSettings then
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.v2RecoverDir = MoveDirection5.Magnitude > 0.03
                and MoveDirection5.Unit
            or nil
        runtimeState.enabledSettings.v2RecoverUntil = tick() + 0.35
    end

    if not (_waveBrainrotCarried() or isMatching13) then
        Cache.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = assemblyLinearVelocity3
        Cache.root.Velocity = assemblyLinearVelocity3
    end

    Cache.root.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
    Cache.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

runtimeState.modeSettings.Loop = function()
    while runtimeState.modeSettings.Mode == "v2" do
        task.wait()

        if runtimeState.modeSettings.IsRagdolled() then
            runtimeState.modeSettings.ForceExit()
        elseif runtimeState.modeSettings.Boosting then
            runtimeState.modeSettings.Boosting = false

            if runtimeState.modeSettings.Cache.humanoid then
                runtimeState.modeSettings.Cache.humanoid.WalkSpeed = runtimeState.modeSettings.DefaultSpeed
                    or 16
            end
        end
    end

    return
end

runtimeState.modeSettings.Start = function()
    if runtimeState.modeSettings.Mode == missingConstants[579] then
        return
    end

    if not runtimeState.modeSettings.CacheChar() then
        return
    end

    runtimeState.modeSettings.Mode = "v2"

    local signalConnection23 = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        runtimeState.modeSettings.Boosting = false
        task.wait(missingConstants[589])
        runtimeState.modeSettings.CacheChar()
    end)

    table.insert(runtimeState.modeSettings.Conns, signalConnection23)
    task.spawn(runtimeState.modeSettings.Loop)
end

runtimeState.modeSettings.Stop = function()
    runtimeState.modeSettings.Mode = nil

    if runtimeState.modeSettings.Boosting and runtimeState.modeSettings.Cache.humanoid then
        runtimeState.modeSettings.Cache.humanoid.WalkSpeed = runtimeState.modeSettings.DefaultSpeed
            or missingConstants[650]
    end

    runtimeState.modeSettings.Boosting = false
    runtimeState.modeSettings.DisconnectAll()
    runtimeState.modeSettings.Cache = {}
end

    return

    if not characterRoot17 then
        return false
    end

    local AssemblyLinearVelocity9 = characterRoot17.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local _tpBatLastSafeCF = application.controller._tpBatLastSafeCF
    local elapsedTime = tick() - (application.controller._tpBatLastSafeAt or missingConstants[182])
    local Magnitude7 = _tpBatLastSafeCF
            and (
                Vector3.new(characterRoot17.Position.X, 0, characterRoot17.Position.Z)
                - Vector3.new(
                    _tpBatLastSafeCF.Position.X,
                    missingConstants[182],
                    _tpBatLastSafeCF.Position.Z
                )
            ).Magnitude
        or 0
    local Magnitude22 =
        Vector3.new(AssemblyLinearVelocity9.X, 0, AssemblyLinearVelocity9.Z).Magnitude

    if
        not (
            characterRoot17.Position.Y < application.controller.TP_BAT_VOID_Y
            or AssemblyLinearVelocity9.Y < -missingConstants[161]
            or _tpBatLastSafeCF
                and elapsedTime < missingConstants[681]
                and Magnitude7 > 35
                and Magnitude22 > missingConstants[374]
        )
    then
        return missingConstants[357]
    end

    local _tpBatLastSafeCF2

    if
        application.controller._tpBatLastSafeCF
        and tick() - application.controller._tpBatLastSafeAt < 5
    then
        _tpBatLastSafeCF2 = application.controller._tpBatLastSafeCF
    end

    if _tpBatLastSafeCF2 then
        characterRoot17.CFrame = _tpBatLastSafeCF2
            + Vector3.new(missingConstants[182], missingConstants[303], 0)
    else
        characterRoot17.CFrame = CFrame.new(
            characterRoot17.Position.X,
            missingConstants[612],
            characterRoot17.Position.Z
        )
    end

    characterRoot17.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    characterRoot17.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

    return true
end

application.controller.applyFPSBoost = function()
    pcall(function()
        setfpscap(missingConstants[200])
    end)

    if
        application.controller._fpsBoostScanActive
        or application.controller._fpsBoostApplied and runtimeState.settings2.fpsBoostEnabled
    then
        return
    end

    application.controller._fpsBoostScanActive = missingConstants[577]
    application.controller._fpsBoostScanId = (application.controller._fpsBoostScanId or 0) + 1

    local _fpsBoostScanId = application.controller._fpsBoostScanId

    local function applyLowDetailObjectSettings(object8)
        pcall(function()
            if object8:IsA("Model") then
                object8.LevelOfDetail = Enum.ModelLevelOfDetail.Disabled
                object8.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Nonatomic
            elseif object8:IsA("MeshPart") then
                object8.CastShadow = missingConstants[357]
                object8.DoubleSided = missingConstants[357]
                object8.RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance
            elseif object8:IsA("BasePart") then
                object8.CastShadow = false
                object8.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
                object8.Reflectance = 0
            elseif object8:IsA("Decal") or object8:IsA(missingConstants[251]) then
                object8.Transparency = missingConstants[711]
            elseif object8:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                object8.TextureId = ""
            elseif
                object8:IsA(missingConstants[623])
                or object8:IsA("SpotLight")
                or object8:IsA("Smoke")
                or object8:IsA(missingConstants[359])
                or object8:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                or object8:IsA(missingConstants[506])
                or object8:IsA(missingConstants[68])
            then
                object8.Enabled = false
            elseif object8:IsA(missingConstants[613]) or object8:IsA(missingConstants[88]) then
                object8:Destroy()
            elseif object8:IsA(missingConstants[131]) then
                object8.Visible = missingConstants[357]
            end
        end)
    end

    if not application.controller._fpsBoostDescConn then
        application.controller._fpsBoostDescConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(
            function(descendant48)
                if runtimeState.settings2.fpsBoostEnabled then
                    task.spawn(applyLowDetailObjectSettings, descendant48)
                end
            end
        )
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local descendants2 = workspace:GetDescendants()

        for i16 = missingConstants[711], #descendants2 do
            if
                not runtimeState.settings2.fpsBoostEnabled
                or application.controller._fpsBoostScanId ~= _fpsBoostScanId
            then
                application.controller._fpsBoostScanActive = false

                return
            end

            applyLowDetailObjectSettings(descendants2[i16])

            if i16 % 30 == 0 then
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end

        application.controller._fpsBoostScanActive = false
        application.controller._fpsBoostApplied = missingConstants[577]
    end)
end

application.controller.findNearestPrompt = function()
    local result245 = application.controller.getHRP()

    if not result245 then
        return
    end

    local result246 = workspace:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[183])

    if not result246 then
        return
    end

    local child322
    local result247
    local huge6 = math.huge

    for _166, child54 in ipairs(result246:GetChildren()) do
        if not application.controller.isMyPlotByName(child54.Name) then
            local result248 = child54:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[542])

            if result248 then
                for _167, child210 in ipairs(result248:GetChildren()) do
                    local result249 = child210:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[14])
                    local result250 = result249 and result249:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[560])

                    if result250 then
                        local Magnitude11 = (result250.Position - result245.Position).Magnitude

                        if
                            Magnitude11 <= runtimeState.stealSettings.StealRadius
                            and Magnitude11 < huge6
                        then
                            local PromptAttachment = result250:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")

                            if PromptAttachment then
                                for _168, child310 in ipairs(PromptAttachment:GetChildren()) do
                                    if child310:IsA(missingConstants[148]) then
                                        if child310.ActionText:find(missingConstants[748]) then
                                            child322 = child310
                                            result247 = result250
                                            huge6 = Magnitude11
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return child322, result247
end

application.controller.executeSteal = function(prompt2, value404)
    if runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive then
        return
    end

    if not runtimeState.stealPromptRecords[prompt2] then
        runtimeState.stealPromptRecords[prompt2] = {
            hold = {},
            trigger = {},
            ready = missingConstants[577],
        }

        if runtimeState.getconnections_ then
            local ok19, result251 =
                pcall(runtimeState.getconnections_, prompt2.PromptButtonHoldBegan)

            if ok19 and type(result251) == missingConstants[371] then
                for _169, value66 in ipairs(result251) do
                    if type(value66.Function) == missingConstants[235] then
                        table.insert(
                            runtimeState.stealPromptRecords[prompt2].hold,
                            value66.Function
                        )
                    end
                end
            end

            local ok25, result252 = pcall(runtimeState.getconnections_, prompt2.Triggered)

            if ok25 and type(result252) == missingConstants[371] then
                for _170, value67 in ipairs(result252) do
                    if type(value67.Function) == missingConstants[235] then
                        table.insert(
                            runtimeState.stealPromptRecords[prompt2].trigger,
                            value67.Function
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local result2512 = runtimeState.stealPromptRecords[prompt2]

    if not result2512.ready then
        return
    end

    result2512.ready = false
    runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok20 = type(fireproximityprompt) ~= missingConstants[235]
            and pcall(function()
                prompt2:InputHoldBegin()
            end)

        local function finishStealPrompt(releasePrompt)
            if releasePrompt and ok20 and prompt2.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    prompt2:InputHoldEnd()
                end)
            end

            if application.controller._waveProgressFill then
                application.controller._waveProgressFill.Size =
                    UDim2.new(0, 0, missingConstants[711], missingConstants[182])
            end

            result2512.ready = true
            runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive = missingConstants[357]
        end
        local function isPromptInStealRange()
            local result2522 = application.controller.getHRP()
            local Parent7 = result2522 and value404 and value404.Parent

            if Parent7 then
                Parent7 = (value404.Position - result2522.Position).Magnitude
                    <= (runtimeState.stealSettings.StealRadius or runtimeState.stealRadius)
            end

            return Parent7
        end
        local function isPromptInInteractionRange()
            local result253 = application.controller.getHRP()
            local Parent8 = result253 and value404 and value404.Parent

            if Parent8 then
                Parent8 = (value404.Position - result253.Position).Magnitude
                    <= (runtimeState.stealSettings.StealRange or missingConstants[474])
            end

            return Parent8
        end

        if not ok20 then
            for _171, value68 in ipairs(result2512.hold) do
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(value68)

                    return
                end)
            end
        end

        local StealDuration = runtimeState.stealSettings.StealDuration
        local PauseProgress = runtimeState.stealSettings.PauseProgress or 0.85
        local now14 = tick()
        local scaledValue2 = StealDuration * PauseProgress

        while true do
            if
                runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive
                and runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                and runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == missingConstants[705]
                and prompt2.Parent
                and tick() - now14 < scaledValue2
            then
                if not isPromptInStealRange() then
                    break
                end

                local clampedValue20 =
                    math.clamp((tick() - now14) / scaledValue2 * PauseProgress, 0, PauseProgress)

                if application.controller._waveProgressFill then
                    application.controller._waveProgressFill.Size =
                        UDim2.new(clampedValue20, missingConstants[182], 1, missingConstants[182])
                end

                task.wait(
                    (runtimeState.stealSettings.Delay or missingConstants[681])
                        / missingConstants[654]
                )

                continue
            end

            if
                not runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive
                or not runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                or not (runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == "Normal" and prompt2.Parent)
            then
                finishStealPrompt(true)

                return
            end

            if application.controller._waveProgressFill then
                application.controller._waveProgressFill.Size =
                    UDim2.new(PauseProgress, 0, missingConstants[711], 0)
            end

            if not isPromptInInteractionRange() then
                local combinedValue23 = tick()
                    + (runtimeState.stealSettings.RangeWait or missingConstants[657])

                repeat
                    task.wait(
                        (runtimeState.stealSettings.Delay or missingConstants[681])
                            / missingConstants[654]
                    )
                until not runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive
                    or not runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                    or runtimeState.settings2.stealMode ~= "Normal"
                    or not prompt2.Parent
                    or not isPromptInStealRange()
                    or isPromptInInteractionRange()
                    or combinedValue23 <= tick()

                if
                    not runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive
                    or not runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                    or runtimeState.settings2.stealMode ~= missingConstants[705]
                    or not prompt2.Parent
                    or not isPromptInStealRange()
                    or not isPromptInInteractionRange()
                then
                    finishStealPrompt(true)

                    return
                end
            end

            local now26 = tick()
            local scaledValue3 = StealDuration * (missingConstants[711] - PauseProgress)

            while true do
                if
                    runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive
                    and runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                    and runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == "Normal"
                    and prompt2.Parent
                    and tick() - now26 < scaledValue3
                then
                    if not isPromptInStealRange() then
                        break
                    end

                    local combinedValue24 = PauseProgress
                        + math.clamp((tick() - now26) / scaledValue3, missingConstants[182], 1)
                            * (1 - PauseProgress)

                    if application.controller._waveProgressFill then
                        application.controller._waveProgressFill.Size =
                            UDim2.new(combinedValue24, 0, missingConstants[711], 0)
                    end

                    task.wait(
                        (runtimeState.stealSettings.Delay or missingConstants[681])
                            / missingConstants[654]
                    )

                    continue
                end

                if
                    not runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive
                    or not runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                    or not (
                        runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == missingConstants[705] and prompt2.Parent
                    )
                then
                    finishStealPrompt(missingConstants[577])

                    return
                end

                if application.controller._waveProgressFill then
                    application.controller._waveProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(
                        missingConstants[711],
                        missingConstants[182],
                        missingConstants[711],
                        missingConstants[182]
                    )
                end

                if type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
                    pcall(function()
                        fireproximityprompt(prompt2, missingConstants[182])
                    end)
                elseif ok20 then
                    pcall(function()
                        prompt2:InputHoldEnd()
                    end)
                else
                    for _172, value69 in ipairs(result2512.trigger) do
                        task.spawn(function()
                            pcall(value69)
                        end)
                    end
                end

                pcall(function()
                    if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and type(_G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup) == "function" then
                        _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup(
                            runtimeState.stealSettings.Stop or missingConstants[424]
                        )
                    end
                end)
                finishStealPrompt(missingConstants[357])

                return
            end

            finishStealPrompt(true)

            return
        end

        finishStealPrompt(missingConstants[577])
    end)
end
application.controller.createWaveStealGUI = function()
    if application.controller._waveStealGui and application.controller._waveStealGui.Parent then
        application.controller._waveStealGui:Destroy()
    end

    local TouchEnabled4 = userInputService.TouchEnabled and missingConstants[176]
        or missingConstants[230]
    local waveStealGui = Instance.new(missingConstants[604])

    waveStealGui.Name = missingConstants[647]
    waveStealGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    waveStealGui.DisplayOrder = missingConstants[488]
    waveStealGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

application.controller.tryKickWarning = function(value406)
    if not runtimeState.settings2.kickWarningEnabled then
        return
    end

    local kickWarningWasCarrying = false

    pcall(function()
        kickWarningWasCarrying = _waveKickWarningCarried and _waveKickWarningCarried() == true
    end)

    if value406 or kickWarningWasCarrying then
        local now16 = tick()

        if value406 then
            application.controller._kickWarningLastFire = now16
            pcall(application.controller.showKickWarningBar)
        elseif kickWarningWasCarrying and not application.controller._kickWarningWasCarrying then
            if now16 - (application.controller._kickWarningLastFire or 0) > 0.85 then
                application.controller._kickWarningLastFire = now16
                pcall(application.controller.showKickWarningBar)
                application.controller._kickWarningWasCarrying = kickWarningWasCarrying

                return
            end
        end
    end

    application.controller._kickWarningWasCarrying = kickWarningWasCarrying
end

application.controller.splitSyncPath = function(value407)
    if typeof(value407) == "table" then
        return value407
    end

    local entries25 = {}

    for match2 in string.gmatch(tostring(value407), "[^%.]+") do
        table.insert(entries25, tonumber(match2) or match2)
    end

    return entries25
end

application.controller.resolveSyncPath = function(value408, value409)
    local result258 = value409
    local result259
    local value712

    for _174, value71 in ipairs(application.controller.splitSyncPath(value408)) do
        result259 = result258
        value712 = value71
        result258 = result258 and result258[value71] or nil
    end

    return result258, result259, value712
end

application.controller.applyPlotSyncDiff = function(value410, value411)
    local result260 = application.controller.plotAnimalSync.caches[value410]

    if typeof(result260) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    local result261 = value411[missingConstants[62]]
    local result262 = value411[missingConstants[303]]
    local result263 = value411[missingConstants[100]]
    local result264, result265, result266 =
        application.controller.resolveSyncPath(value411[1], result260)

    if result261 == missingConstants[372] then
        if result265 then
            result265[result266] = result262
        end
    elseif result261 == missingConstants[735] then
        if result264 then
            table.insert(result264, result263, result262)
        end
    elseif result261 == "ArrayRemoved" then
        if result264 then
            table.remove(result264, result263)
        end
    elseif result261 == missingConstants[685] then
        if result264 then
            result264[result263] = result262
        end
    elseif result261 == "DictionaryRemoved" and result264 then
        result264[result263] = nil
    end
end

application.controller.attachPlotChannel = function(value412, value413, value414)
    if application.controller.plotAnimalSync.connections[value412] then
        return
    end

    local textValue4 = tostring(value412.Name)

    if not value414:FindFirstChild(textValue4) then
        return
    end

    if value413.requestData and application.controller.plotAnimalSync.caches[textValue4] == nil then
        local ok21, result267 = pcall(function()
            return value413.requestData:InvokeServer(textValue4)
        end)

        application.controller.plotAnimalSync.caches[textValue4] = ok21
                and typeof(result267) == missingConstants[371]
                and result267
            or {}
    elseif application.controller.plotAnimalSync.caches[textValue4] == nil then
        application.controller.plotAnimalSync.caches[textValue4] = {}
    end

    application.controller.plotAnimalSync.connections[value412] = value412.OnClientEvent:Connect(
        function(value415)
            for _175, value72 in ipairs(value415) do
                application.controller.applyPlotSyncDiff(textValue4, value72)
            end
        end
    )
end

        end
    end
end
application.controller._stealSyncConns = {}

application.controller.setupSync = function()
    local ok26, result268 = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    end)

    if not ok26 then
        return
    end

    local ok27, result269 = pcall(function()
        return result268:WaitForChild("Packages", missingConstants[681])
    end)

    if not ok27 or not result269 then
        return
    end

    local ok32, result310 = pcall(function()
        return result269:WaitForChild("Synchronizer", missingConstants[681])
    end)

    if not ok32 or not result310 then
        return
    end

    local Plots3 = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")

    if not Plots3 then
        return
    end

    local channelFolderSettings = {
        channelFolder = result310:FindFirstChild("Channel"),
        routeRemote = result310:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[640]),
        requestData = result310:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[420]),
    }

    if not channelFolderSettings.channelFolder or not channelFolderSettings.routeRemote then
        return
    end

    for _176, child55 in ipairs(channelFolderSettings.channelFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if child55:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            application.controller.attachPlotChannel(child55, channelFolderSettings, Plots3)
        end
    end

    local signalConnection30 = channelFolderSettings.channelFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(
        function(child56)
            if child56:IsA(missingConstants[573]) then
                application.controller.attachPlotChannel(child56, channelFolderSettings, Plots3)
            end
        end
    )
    local signalConnection31 = channelFolderSettings.routeRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(
        function(value417)
            for _177, value73 in ipairs(value417) do
                local result2672 = value73[missingConstants[711]]
                local textValue5 = tostring(value73[missingConstants[62]])

                if Plots3:FindFirstChild(textValue5) then
                    if result2672 == "ListenerAdded" then
                        local result2682 =
                            channelFolderSettings.channelFolder:FindFirstChild(textValue5)

                        if result2682 and result2682:IsA(missingConstants[573]) then
                            application.controller.attachPlotChannel(
                                result2682,
                                channelFolderSettings,
                                Plots3
                            )
                        end
                    elseif result2672 == missingConstants[737] then
                        application.controller.detachPlotChannel(textValue5)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    )

    application.controller._stealSyncConns = {
        signalConnection30,
        signalConnection31,
    }
end

application.controller.stopSync = function()
    for _178, stealSyncConn in ipairs(application.controller._stealSyncConns) do
        pcall(function()
            stealSyncConn:Disconnect()
        end)
    end

    application.controller._stealSyncConns = {}
    application.controller.plotAnimalSync = {
        caches = {},
        connections = {},
    }
end

application.controller.distToAnimal = function(value421)
    local result275 = application.controller.getHRP()

    if not result275 then
        return math.huge
    end

    local result276 = application.controller.getAnimalPosition(value421)

    if result276 then
        return (result275.Position - result276).Magnitude
    end

    return math.huge
end

application.controller.getPromptPosition = function(value422)
    if not value422 or not value422.Parent then
        return nil
    end

    local Parent9 = value422.Parent

    if Parent9:IsA(missingConstants[131]) then
        return Parent9.WorldPosition
    end

    if Parent9:IsA(missingConstants[729]) then
        return Parent9.Position
    end

    local result277 = Parent9:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA(missingConstants[729])

    return result277 and result277.Position or nil
end

application.controller.distToStealPrompt = function(value423, value424)
    local result278 = application.controller.getHRP()

    if not result278 then
        return math.huge
    end

    local result279 = application.controller.getPromptPosition(value423)
        or application.controller.getAnimalPosition(value424)

    if result279 then
        return (result278.Position - result279).Magnitude
    end

    return math.huge
end
application.controller.inPromptStealRange = function(value425, value426, value427)
    local STEAL_RANGE = CONFIG_STEAL.STEAL_RANGE or 9

    if value425 and value425.Parent then
        local ok30, result280 = pcall(function()
            return value425.MaxActivationDistance
        end)

        if ok30 and tonumber(result280) then
            STEAL_RANGE = math.max(STEAL_RANGE, tonumber(result280))
        end
    end

    local result2802 = application.controller.distToStealPrompt(value425, value426)
    local result281 = value427 or missingConstants[182]

    return result2802 <= STEAL_RANGE + result281
end

application.controller.pickClosest = function()
    local result282 = application.controller.getHRP()

    if not result282 then
        return nil
    end

    local value752
    local huge7 = math.huge

    for _180, value75 in ipairs(application.controller.allAnimalsCache) do
        if not application.controller.isMyBaseAnimal(value75) then
            local result283 = application.controller.getAnimalPosition(value75)

            if result283 then
                local Magnitude12 = (result282.Position - result283).Magnitude

                if not (CONFIG_STEAL.PRIME_RANGE < Magnitude12) and Magnitude12 < huge7 then
                    huge7 = Magnitude12
                    value752 = value75
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return value752
end

application.controller._semiWatchPickupReliable = function(value429)
    task.spawn(function()
        local combinedValue25 = tick() + 0.45
        local AutoCarrySpeed

        while true do
            AutoCarrySpeed = _G.AutoCarrySpeed

            if AutoCarrySpeed and type(AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup) == missingConstants[235] then
                break
            else
                task.wait()

                if combinedValue25 < tick() then
                    return
                end
            end
        end

        local combinedValue26 = tick() + missingConstants[290]

        repeat
            pcall(function()
                AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup(value429 or missingConstants[75])
            end)
            task.wait(0.05)
        until combinedValue26 < tick()

        return
    end)
end
application.controller.buildStealCallbacks = function(prompt3)
    if application.controller.InternalStealCache[prompt3] then
        return
    end

    local holdCallbacksSettings = {
        holdCallbacks = {},
        triggerCallbacks = {},
        ready = missingConstants[577],
    }
    local ok31, result290 = pcall(runtimeState.getconnections_, prompt3.PromptButtonHoldBegan)

    if ok31 and type(result290) == missingConstants[371] then
        for _182, value76 in ipairs(result290) do
            if type(value76.Function) == missingConstants[235] then
                table.insert(holdCallbacksSettings.holdCallbacks, value76.Function)
            end
        end
    end

    local ok210, result291 = pcall(runtimeState.getconnections_, prompt3.Triggered)

    if ok210 and type(result291) == "table" then
        for _183, value77 in ipairs(result291) do
            if type(value77.Function) == "function" then
                table.insert(holdCallbacksSettings.triggerCallbacks, value77.Function)
            end
        end
    end

    if
        missingConstants[182] < #holdCallbacksSettings.holdCallbacks
        or #holdCallbacksSettings.triggerCallbacks > 0
    then
        application.controller.InternalStealCache[prompt3] = holdCallbacksSettings
    end
end
application.controller.executeStealAsync = function(value430, value431)
    if not value430 or not value430.Parent or not value431 then
        return missingConstants[357]
    end

    application.controller.buildStealCallbacks(value430)

    local result2902 = application.controller.InternalStealCache[value430]

    if not result2902 or not result2902.ready then
        return false
    end

    result2902.ready = missingConstants[357]
    application.controller.StealState.active = missingConstants[577]
    application.controller.StealState.startTime = tick()
    application.controller.StealState.phase = missingConstants[528]
    application.controller.StealState.label = value431.name or "Animal"

    local function updateStealProgress(progressFraction)
        pcall(function()
            local clampedValue21 =
                math.clamp(tonumber(progressFraction) or 0, 0, missingConstants[711])

            if application.controller._waveProgressFill then
                application.controller._waveProgressFill.Size =
                    UDim2.new(clampedValue21, missingConstants[182], missingConstants[711], 0)
            end

            if application.controller._wavePercentLbl then
                application.controller._wavePercentLbl.Text = tostring(
                    math.floor(clampedValue21 * 100 + missingConstants[589])
                ) .. "%"
            end
        end)
    end
    local function getStealLabelColor()
        return application.controller._kiraThemeActive
                and application.controller._kiraThemeActive()
                and runtimeState.waveUITheme.sectionTxt
            or Color3.fromRGB(30, missingConstants[176], missingConstants[668])
    end
    local function cancelStealColorTween()
        if application.controller._waveStealColorTween then
            pcall(function()
                application.controller._waveStealColorTween:Cancel()
            end)
            application.controller._waveStealColorTween = nil
        end
    end
    local function resetStealProgress()
        pcall(function()
            cancelStealColorTween()

            if application.controller._waveProgressFill then
                application.controller._waveProgressFill.Size =
                    UDim2.new(0, missingConstants[182], missingConstants[711], 0)
                application.controller._waveProgressFill.BackgroundColor3 = getStealLabelColor()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function primeStealPrompt(prompt)
        task.spawn(function()
            local combinedValue27 = tick() + missingConstants[156]
            local AutoCarrySpeed2

            while true do
                AutoCarrySpeed2 = _G.AutoCarrySpeed

                if AutoCarrySpeed2 and type(AutoCarrySpeed2.WatchPickup) == "function" then
                    break
                else
                    task.wait()

                    if combinedValue27 < tick() then
                        return
                    end
                end
            end

            local combinedValue28 = tick() + missingConstants[290]

            repeat
                pcall(function()
                    AutoCarrySpeed2.WatchPickup(prompt or 1.25)
                end)
                task.wait(0.05)
            until combinedValue28 < tick()
        end)

        return
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local startTime = application.controller.StealState.startTime

        resetStealProgress()

        if result2902 then
            for _184, holdCallback in ipairs(result2902.holdCallbacks) do
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(holdCallback)
                end)
            end
        end

        while
            runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
            and runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == "Semi"
            and tick() - startTime < CONFIG_STEAL.HOLD_MIN
        do
            updateStealProgress((tick() - startTime) / CONFIG_STEAL.HOLD_MAX)
            task.wait()
        end

        application.controller.StealState.phase = missingConstants[376]
        pcall(function()
            if application.controller._waveProgressFill then
                cancelStealColorTween()
                application.controller._waveStealColorTween = tweenService:Create(
                    application.controller._waveProgressFill,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
                    {
                        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
                            missingConstants[571],
                            missingConstants[571],
                            255
                        ),
                    }
                )
                application.controller._waveStealColorTween:Play()
            end
        end)

        local isEnabled32 = missingConstants[357]
        local isMatching17 = application.controller.distToAnimal(value431)
            <= (tonumber(CONFIG_STEAL.STEAL_RANGE) or missingConstants[550])
        local exitTo6
        local elapsedTime2

        while true do
            local ok33 = not runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                or not (runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == "Semi" and value430.Parent)

            if not ok33 then
                elapsedTime2 = tick() - startTime
                ok33 = not not (CONFIG_STEAL.HOLD_MAX < elapsedTime2)
            end

            if ok33 then
                exitTo6 = 1

                break
            end

            updateStealProgress(elapsedTime2 / CONFIG_STEAL.HOLD_MAX)

            if
                not (
                    application.controller.distToAnimal(value431)
                    <= (tonumber(CONFIG_STEAL.STEAL_RANGE) or 9)
                )
            then
                task.wait()

                continue
            end

            break
        end

        local StealState, StealState2

        if exitTo6 == 1 then
            application.controller.StealState.active = false

            if isEnabled32 then
                StealState2 = application.controller.StealState
                StealState2.totalSteals += missingConstants[711]
            else
                StealState = application.controller.StealState
                StealState.failedSteals += missingConstants[711]
            end
        else
            if not isMatching17 then
                primeStealPrompt(1.25)

                local now17 = tick()
                local barPauseUntil = now17 + (CONFIG_STEAL.ENTRY_DELAY or 0.3)

                application.controller.StealState.phase = missingConstants[136]
                application.controller.StealState.barPauseStarted = now17
                application.controller.StealState.barPauseTotal = CONFIG_STEAL.ENTRY_DELAY or 0.3
                application.controller.StealState.barPauseUntil = barPauseUntil

                while
                    runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                    and runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == missingConstants[147]
                    and value430.Parent
                    and tick() < barPauseUntil
                do
                    task.wait()
                end

                local combinedValue29 = startTime + (tick() - now17)

                application.controller.StealState.barPauseStarted = missingConstants[182]
                application.controller.StealState.barPauseTotal = 0
                application.controller.StealState.barPauseUntil = missingConstants[182]
                application.controller.StealState.phase = missingConstants[376]
            end

            if
                runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                and runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == missingConstants[147]
            then
                if result2902 then
                    for _185, triggerCallback in ipairs(result2902.triggerCallbacks) do
                        task.spawn(function()
                            pcall(triggerCallback)
                        end)
                    end
                end

                primeStealPrompt(missingConstants[75])
                isEnabled32 = true
                application.controller.StealState.active = false

                if isEnabled32 then
                    StealState2 = application.controller.StealState
                    StealState2.totalSteals += missingConstants[711]
                else
                    StealState = application.controller.StealState
                    StealState.failedSteals += missingConstants[711]
                end
            else
                application.controller.StealState.active = false

                if isEnabled32 then
                    StealState2 = application.controller.StealState
                    StealState2.totalSteals += missingConstants[711]
                else
                    StealState = application.controller.StealState
                    StealState.failedSteals += missingConstants[711]
                end
            end
        end

        application.controller.StealState.lastResult = isEnabled32
                and missingConstants[64] .. tostring(application.controller.StealState.label)
            or "Missed window: " .. tostring(application.controller.StealState.label)
        application.controller.StealState.phase = missingConstants[157]
        application.controller.StealState.lastResultTime = tick()

        if isEnabled32 then
            updateStealProgress(missingConstants[711])
        end

        task.wait(CONFIG_STEAL.COOLDOWN)

        if result2902 then
            result2902.ready = true
        end

        resetStealProgress()
    end)

    return missingConstants[577]
end
application.controller.startAutoStealInstinct = function()
    runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled = true
    runtimeState.stealPromptRecords = {}
    runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive = missingConstants[357]

    if
        not application.controller._waveStealGui or not application.controller._waveStealGui.Parent
    then
        application.controller.createWaveStealGUI()
    end

    if runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == missingConstants[147] then
        application.controller.allAnimalsCache = {}
        application.controller.PromptMemoryCache = {}
        application.controller.InternalStealCache = {}
        application.controller.SemiRangeMemory = {}
        application.controller.StealState = {
            active = missingConstants[357],
            startTime = missingConstants[182],
            phase = "idle",
            label = "",
            dist = 0,
            lastResult = "",
            lastResultTime = 0,
            totalSteals = missingConstants[182],
            failedSteals = missingConstants[182],
            barPauseUntil = 0,
            barPauseStarted = 0,
            barPauseTotal = 0,
        }
        task.spawn(function()
            application.controller.setupSync()
            task.wait(missingConstants[589])
            application.controller.scanAllPlots()
        end)

        if application.controller.stealConnection then
            application.controller.stealConnection:Disconnect()
            application.controller.stealConnection = nil
        end

        application.controller._semiStealHbAcc = 0
        application.controller.stealConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt6)
            if not runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled then
                return
            end

            application.controller._semiStealHbAcc += dt6

            if application.controller._semiStealHbAcc < missingConstants[718] then
                return
            end

            application.controller._semiStealHbAcc = missingConstants[182]

            local result2912 = application.controller.pickClosest()

            if not result2912 then
                return
            end

            local result292 = application.controller.PromptMemoryCache[result2912.uid]

            if not result292 or not result292.Parent then
                result292 = application.controller.findProximityPromptForAnimal(result2912)
            end

            local result293 = application.controller.inPromptStealRange(result292, result2912, 0.35)
            local result294 = application.controller.SemiRangeMemory[result2912.uid]

            if result294 == nil then
                result294 = result293
            end

            if result293 and not result294 then
                application.controller._semiWatchPickupReliable(missingConstants[75])
            end

            application.controller.SemiRangeMemory[result2912.uid] = result293

            if application.controller.StealState.active then
                return
            end

            if result292 then
                application.controller.executeStealAsync(result292, result2912)
            end
        end)
        runtimeState.antiRagSettings.autoStealInstinct = application.controller.stealConnection
        task.spawn(function()
            while
                runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled
                and runtimeState.settings2.stealMode == missingConstants[147]
            do
                task.wait(5)
                application.controller.scanAllPlots()
            end
        end)

        if application.controller._stealUIUpdater then
            application.controller._stealUIUpdater:Disconnect()
            application.controller._stealUIUpdater = nil
        end
    else
        if not application.controller._waveStealHBConn then
            application.controller._normalStealHbAcc = missingConstants[182]
            application.controller._waveStealHBConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt7)
                if
                    not runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled or runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive
                then
                    return
                end

                application.controller._normalStealHbAcc += dt7

                if application.controller._normalStealHbAcc < missingConstants[570] then
                    return
                end

                application.controller._normalStealHbAcc = 0

                local result295, result296 = application.controller.findNearestPrompt()

                if result295 then
                    application.controller.executeSteal(result295, result296)
                end
            end)
        end

        runtimeState.antiRagSettings.autoStealInstinct = application.controller._waveStealHBConn
    end
end
application.controller.stopAutoStealInstinct = function()
    runtimeState.stealSettings.Enabled = missingConstants[357]
    runtimeState.isAutomaticStealActive = missingConstants[357]
    application.controller.StealState.active = missingConstants[357]
    application.controller.StealState.barPauseUntil = missingConstants[182]
    application.controller.StealState.barPauseStarted = missingConstants[182]
    application.controller.StealState.barPauseTotal = missingConstants[182]

    if application.controller._waveStealHBConn then
        application.controller._waveStealHBConn:Disconnect()
        application.controller._waveStealHBConn = nil
    end

    if application.controller.stealConnection then
        application.controller.stealConnection:Disconnect()
        application.controller.stealConnection = nil
    end

    if application.controller._stealUIUpdater then
        application.controller._stealUIUpdater:Disconnect()
        application.controller._stealUIUpdater = nil
    end

    if runtimeState.antiRagSettings.autoStealInstinct then
        runtimeState.antiRagSettings.autoStealInstinct:Disconnect()
        runtimeState.antiRagSettings.autoStealInstinct = nil
    end

    application.controller.stopSync()

    if application.controller._waveProgressFill then
        application.controller._waveProgressFill.Size =
            UDim2.new(0, 0, missingConstants[711], missingConstants[182])
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    Color3.fromRGB(45, missingConstants[116], 230)

    local isEnabled33 = missingConstants[357]
    local platformStand = missingConstants[357]
    local isMedusaFrozen = missingConstants[357]

    local function findRagdollTimerLabel()
        local Character58 = LocalPlayer.Character

        if not Character58 then
            return nil
        end

        local result307 = Character58:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[497])

        if not result307 then
            return nil
        end

        local result308 = result307:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[162])

        if result308 then
            return result308:FindFirstChild("RagdollTimerLbl")
        end

        return nil
    end
    local function updateRagdollTimerDisplay(remainingTime)
        local isEnabled34 = missingConstants[357]

        if remainingTime and remainingTime >= 3.5 then
            isEnabled34 = true
            runtimeState.settings2._pendingMedusaRagdollTimerUntil = nil
            runtimeState.settings2._forceNextRagdollTimerDuration = nil
            runtimeState.settings2._forceNextRagdollTimerUntil = nil
        end

        if isEnabled33 then
            if not isEnabled34 then
                return
            end

            runtimeState.settings2._ragdollTimerToken = (
                runtimeState.settings2._ragdollTimerToken or missingConstants[182]
            ) + missingConstants[711]
            isEnabled33 = missingConstants[357]
        end

        isEnabled33 = true
        runtimeState.settings2._ragdollTimerToken = (
            runtimeState.settings2._ragdollTimerToken or missingConstants[182]
        ) + 1

        local _ragdollTimerToken = runtimeState.settings2._ragdollTimerToken

        task.spawn(function()
            local result309 = missingConstants[711]
            local remainingTime3 = remainingTime or 2.5

            for i17 = math.max(result309, math.floor(remainingTime3 * 10 + 0.5)), missingConstants[711], -missingConstants[711] do
                if _ragdollTimerToken ~= runtimeState.settings2._ragdollTimerToken then
                    return
                end

                local ragdollTimerLabel = findRagdollTimerLabel()

                if ragdollTimerLabel then
                    ragdollTimerLabel.Text = string.format("%.1f", i17 * missingConstants[697])
                end

                task.wait(missingConstants[697])
            end

            if _ragdollTimerToken ~= runtimeState.settings2._ragdollTimerToken then
                return
            end

            local ragdollTimerLabel2 = findRagdollTimerLabel()

            if ragdollTimerLabel2 then
                ragdollTimerLabel2.Text = ""
            end

            isEnabled33 = missingConstants[357]
        end)
    end

    application.controller._startWaveRagdollTimer = function()
        if application.controller._ragdollTimerMonitor then
            return
        end

        application.controller._ragdollTimerMonitor = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not runtimeState.settings2.ragdollTimerEnabled then
                return
            end

            local Character59 = LocalPlayer.Character

            if not Character59 then
                return
            end
