runtimeState.initializeEnemyStatusDisplays = function()
    local entries26 = {}
    local enabledSettings4 = {
        Enabled = missingConstants[577],
        Duration = missingConstants[87],
    }
    local counter23 = 0

    local function resetEnemyRagdollDisplay(displayRecord)
        if not displayRecord then
            return
        end

        displayRecord.token = (displayRecord.token or missingConstants[182]) + missingConstants[711]
        displayRecord.ragdolled = missingConstants[357]
        displayRecord.active = missingConstants[357]

        if displayRecord.rlbl then
            displayRecord.rlbl.Text = ""
        end
    end
    local function startEnemyRagdollCountdown(player52, remainingTime2, character152)
        local result315 = entries26[player52]

        if not result315 or not result315.rlbl or not remainingTime2 then
            return
        end

        resetEnemyRagdollDisplay(result315)
        result315.active = true
        result315.token = (result315.token or 0) + missingConstants[711]

        local token = result315.token

        task.spawn(function()
            local Duration = character152 or enabledSettings4.Duration

            while
                enabledSettings4.Enabled
                and runtimeState.settings2.enemyRagdollTimerEnabled
                and entries26[player52] == result315
                and result315.token == token
                and Duration > 0
            do
                if result315.rlbl and result315.rlbl.Parent then
                    result315.rlbl.Text = string.format("%.1f", Duration)
                    result315.rlbl.TextColor3 =
                        Color3.new(missingConstants[711], missingConstants[711], 1)
                    result315.rlbl.Visible = runtimeState.settings2.enemySpeedEnabled
                        and runtimeState.settings2.enemyRagdollTimerEnabled
                end

                task.wait(missingConstants[697])
                Duration -= missingConstants[697]
            end

            if entries26[player52] == result315 and result315.token == token then
                resetEnemyRagdollDisplay(result315)
            end
        end)
    end
    local function readEnemyRagdollState(character162, humanoid4, currentTime, fallbackDuration)
        local serverTimeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        local attribute4 = character162:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
            or humanoid4:GetAttribute(missingConstants[197])
            or currentTime:GetAttribute(missingConstants[197])

        if type(attribute4) == "number" and serverTimeNow < attribute4 then
            fallbackDuration.lastRagdollEndTime = attribute4

            return missingConstants[577]
        end

        if
            character162:GetAttribute("Ragdolled") == missingConstants[577]
            or character162:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") == missingConstants[577]
            or humanoid4:GetAttribute(missingConstants[691]) == missingConstants[577]
            or humanoid4:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") == missingConstants[577]
            or currentTime:GetAttribute(missingConstants[691]) == true
            or currentTime:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") == true
        then
            return true
        end

        local state8 = currentTime:GetState()

        if
            currentTime.PlatformStand
            or state8 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            or state8 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            or state8 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
        then
            return true
        end

        fallbackDuration.constraintRagdoll = false

        return missingConstants[357]
    end

    local function connectEnemyStatusDisplay(player25)
        if player25 == LocalPlayer then
            return
        end

        local function refreshEnemyStatusAfterRespawn()
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(missingConstants[697])
                createEnemyStatusDisplay(player25)
            end)
        end

        if player25.Character then
            refreshEnemyStatusAfterRespawn()
        end

        player25.CharacterAdded:Connect(refreshEnemyStatusAfterRespawn)
    end

    players2.PlayerAdded:Connect(connectEnemyStatusDisplay)
    players2.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeEnemyStatusDisplay)

        connectEnemyStatusDisplay(player26)
    end

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt10)
        if not runtimeState.settings2.enemySpeedEnabled then
            return
        end

        counter23 += dt10

        if counter23 < missingConstants[718] then
            return
        end

        counter23 = missingConstants[182]

        local players = players2:GetPlayers()

        for i19 = missingConstants[711], #players do
            local player132 = players[i19]

            if player132 ~= LocalPlayer then
                local Character65 = player132.Character
                local character31 = Character65
                    and Character65:FindFirstChild(missingConstants[497])

                if not character31 then
                    removeEnemyStatusDisplay(player132)

                    continue
                end

                local enemyStatusDisplay =
                    createEnemyStatusDisplay(player132, Character65, nil, character31)

                if enemyStatusDisplay and enemyStatusDisplay.lbl then
                    local AssemblyLinearVelocity10 = character31.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    local vector262 =
                        Vector3.new(AssemblyLinearVelocity10.X, 0, AssemblyLinearVelocity10.Z)
                    local Humanoid15 = Character65:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local humanoid13 = Humanoid15
                            and Vector3.new(
                                Humanoid15.MoveDirection.X,
                                missingConstants[182],
                                Humanoid15.MoveDirection.Z
                            )
                        or Vector3.zero
                    local Magnitude14 = humanoid13.Magnitude > 0.03
                            and math.max(0, vector262:Dot(humanoid13.Unit))
                        or vector262.Magnitude

                    enemyStatusDisplay.speed = Magnitude14

                    if Magnitude14 < missingConstants[718] then
                        Magnitude14 = 0
                    end

                    enemyStatusDisplay.lastText = enemyStatusDisplay.lastText or ""

                    local text18 = string.format("%.1f", Magnitude14)

                    if enemyStatusDisplay.lastText ~= text18 then
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lbl.Text = text18
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lastText = text18
                    end

                    if
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lbl.TextColor3
                        ~= Color3.new(missingConstants[711], 1, missingConstants[711])
                    then
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lbl.TextColor3 =
                            Color3.new(1, missingConstants[711], missingConstants[711])
                    end

                    if
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lastVisible ~= runtimeState.settings2.enemySpeedEnabled
                    then
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lbl.Visible = runtimeState.settings2.enemySpeedEnabled
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lastVisible = runtimeState.settings2.enemySpeedEnabled
                    end

                    if enemyStatusDisplay.rlbl then
                        if
                            not (
                                runtimeState.settings2.enemyRagdollTimerEnabled
                                or enemyStatusDisplay.rlbl.Text == ""
                            )
                        then
                            enemyStatusDisplay.rlbl.Text = ""
                        end

                        local enemyRagdollTimerEnabled6 = runtimeState.settings2.enemySpeedEnabled
                            and runtimeState.settings2.enemyRagdollTimerEnabled

                        if enemyRagdollTimerEnabled6 then
                            enemyRagdollTimerEnabled6 = (enemyStatusDisplay.rlbl.Text or "") ~= ""
                        end

                        if enemyStatusDisplay.lastTimerVisible ~= enemyRagdollTimerEnabled6 then
                            enemyStatusDisplay.rlbl.Visible = enemyRagdollTimerEnabled6
                            enemyStatusDisplay.lastTimerVisible = enemyRagdollTimerEnabled6
                        end

                        if
                            enemyStatusDisplay.rlbl.TextColor3
                            ~= Color3.new(1, missingConstants[711], 1)
                        then
                            enemyStatusDisplay.rlbl.TextColor3 =
                                Color3.new(1, missingConstants[711], 1)
                        end
                    end
                end

                if enemyStatusDisplay then
                    local hum5 = enemyStatusDisplay.hum

                    if enemyStatusDisplay.character ~= Character65 then
                        if enemyStatusDisplay.runConn then
                            pcall(function()
                                enemyStatusDisplay.runConn:Disconnect()
                            end)
                        end

                        enemyStatusDisplay.character = Character65
                        enemyStatusDisplay.hum =
                            Character65:FindFirstChildOfClass(missingConstants[322])
                        hum5 = enemyStatusDisplay.hum
                        enemyStatusDisplay.ragdolled = missingConstants[357]
                        enemyStatusDisplay.medusaFrozen = missingConstants[357]
                        enemyStatusDisplay.medusaTimerUntil = nil
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lastPos = character31.Position
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lastSample = missingConstants[182]
                        enemyStatusDisplay.speed = missingConstants[182]
                        enemyStatusDisplay.runningSpeed = 0
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lastText = ""
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lastVisible = missingConstants[357]
                        enemyStatusDisplay.lastTimerVisible = false

                        local hum22 = enemyStatusDisplay.hum

                        if hum22 then
                            enemyStatusDisplay.runConn = hum22.Running:Connect(function(value436)
                                enemyStatusDisplay.runningSpeed = tonumber(value436)
                                    or missingConstants[182]
                            end)
                        end

                        resetEnemyRagdollDisplay(enemyStatusDisplay)
                    end

                    if
                        not enabledSettings4.Enabled
                        or not runtimeState.settings2.enemyRagdollTimerEnabled
                        or not hum5
                        or not (hum5.Health > 0)
                    then
                        enemyStatusDisplay.ragdolled = false
                        enemyStatusDisplay.medusaFrozen = missingConstants[357]
                        enemyStatusDisplay.medusaTimerUntil = nil
                    elseif
                        application.controller._isMedusaFrozen
                            and application.controller._isMedusaFrozen(Character65)
                        or missingConstants[357]
                    then
                        enemyStatusDisplay.medusaFrozen = true
                        enemyStatusDisplay.ragdolled = missingConstants[577]
                    elseif enemyStatusDisplay.medusaFrozen then
                        enemyStatusDisplay.medusaFrozen = false
                        enemyStatusDisplay.ragdolled = true
                        enemyStatusDisplay.medusaTimerUntil = tick() + 3.7
                        startEnemyRagdollCountdown(player132, Character65, missingConstants[385])
                        enemyStatusDisplay.ragdolled = true
                    elseif
                        enemyStatusDisplay.medusaTimerUntil
                        and tick() < enemyStatusDisplay.medusaTimerUntil
                    then
                        enemyStatusDisplay.ragdolled = missingConstants[577]
                    else
                        enemyStatusDisplay.medusaTimerUntil = nil

                        local ragdolled =
                            readEnemyRagdollState(player132, Character65, hum5, enemyStatusDisplay)

                        if ragdolled and not enemyStatusDisplay.ragdolled then
                            startEnemyRagdollCountdown(player132, Character65)
                        end

                        enemyStatusDisplay.ragdolled = ragdolled
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    return

    )
    application.controller._appearScaleTween:Play()
    application.controller._appearScaleTween.Completed:Connect(function()
        application.controller._startupAppearRunning = false
        runtimeState.parent8.Position = application.controller.clampGuiToViewport(
            runtimeState.parent8,
            runtimeState.parent8.Position
        )

        application.controller._appearScaleTween = nil
        application.controller._appearTargetPos = nil

        application.controller._appearTargetScale = nil
    end)
end

_G._waveResetPageLayout = function()
    runtimeState.frame3.Position = UDim2.new(
        missingConstants[182],
        8,
        0,
        runtimeState.collapsedInterfaceHeight + missingConstants[303]
    )
    runtimeState.scrollingFrame.Position =
        UDim2.new(0, 3, missingConstants[182], runtimeState.refreshSettingsLayout)
    runtimeState.scrollingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(
        1,
        -missingConstants[303],
        missingConstants[711],
        -runtimeState.refreshSettingsLayout
    )

    for _195, value83 in pairs(runtimeState.settingsPages) do
        if value83 ~= runtimeState.scrollingFrame then
            value83.Position =
                UDim2.new(0, missingConstants[303], 0, runtimeState.refreshSettingsLayout)
            value83.Size = UDim2.new(
                missingConstants[711],
                -missingConstants[303],
                missingConstants[711],
                -runtimeState.refreshSettingsLayout
            )
        end
    end
end
toggleMinimize = function()
    isMinimized = not isMinimized
    runtimeState.settings2.uiMinimized = isMinimized
    runtimeState.saveConfigurationUnlessLoading()

    if isMinimized then
        for _196, value84 in pairs(runtimeState.settingsPages) do
            value84.Visible = false
        end

        runtimeState.minimizedTitleImage.Visible = missingConstants[357]
        runtimeState.imageButton.Visible = missingConstants[357]
        runtimeState.textLabel.Visible = missingConstants[357]
        runtimeState.applyMiniRestoreTheme()
        runtimeState.updateMinimizeButton()
        runtimeState.parent8.Visible = true
        runtimeState.parent8.Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            runtimeState.counter,
            missingConstants[182],
            runtimeState.expandedInterfaceHeight
        )

        local tween2 = tweenService:Create(
            runtimeState.parent8,
            TweenInfo.new(missingConstants[290], Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            {
                Size = UDim2.new(
                    missingConstants[182],
                    runtimeState.counter,
                    missingConstants[182],
                    runtimeState.collapsedInterfaceHeight
                ),
            }
        )

        tween2:Play()
        tween2.Completed:Connect(function()
            if isMinimized then
                runtimeState.parent8.Visible = missingConstants[357]
                runtimeState.updateMainInterfaceLayout()
            end
        end)
    else
        runtimeState.imageButton.Visible = missingConstants[357]
        runtimeState.textLabel.Visible = missingConstants[357]
        _G._waveResetPageLayout()
        runtimeState.parent8.Visible = missingConstants[577]
        runtimeState.parent8.Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            runtimeState.counter,
            missingConstants[182],
            runtimeState.collapsedInterfaceHeight
        )

        local frame23 = runtimeState.headerBar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")

        if frame23 then
            frame23.Visible = missingConstants[577]
        end

        runtimeState.waveText.Visible = missingConstants[577]
        runtimeState.minimizedTitleImage.Visible = missingConstants[357]

        if runtimeState.menuBgImage then
            runtimeState.menuBgImage.Visible = true
            runtimeState.menuBgImage.Size =
                UDim2.new(1, missingConstants[182], missingConstants[711], 0)
            runtimeState.menuBgImage.Position =
                UDim2.new(missingConstants[182], missingConstants[182], missingConstants[182], 0)
        end

        if runtimeState.frame2 then
            runtimeState.frame2.Visible = missingConstants[577]
            runtimeState.frame2.Size = UDim2.new(1, missingConstants[182], missingConstants[711], 0)
        end

        local tween3 = tweenService:Create(
            runtimeState.parent8,
            TweenInfo.new(missingConstants[290], Enum.EasingStyle.Quad),
            {
                Size = UDim2.new(
                    missingConstants[182],
                    runtimeState.counter,
                    missingConstants[182],
                    runtimeState.expandedInterfaceHeight
                ),
            }
        )

        tween3:Play()
        tween3.Completed:Connect(function()
            if not isMinimized then
                runtimeState.selectSettingsPage(runtimeState.selectedSettingsPage)
            end
        end)
    end

    task.delay(missingConstants[177], function()
        runtimeState.parent8.Position = application.controller.clampGuiToViewport(
            runtimeState.parent8,
            runtimeState.parent8.Position
        )
    end)
end
runtimeState.textButton.Activated:Connect(toggleMinimize)
application.controller.activateMiniRestore = function()
    if runtimeState.wasInterfaceDragged then
        runtimeState.wasInterfaceDragged = false

        return
    end

    toggleMinimize()
end
runtimeState.imageButton.Activated:Connect(application.controller.activateMiniRestore)
runtimeState.textLabel.InputEnded:Connect(function(input41)
    if
        input41.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input41.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
        application.controller.activateMiniRestore()
    end
end)
return
